about: The debut double album by the horn-driven rock band later known simply as Chicago, released by Columbia and produced by James William Guercio. It blended rock, jazz and pop, and the group shortened its name soon afterward under legal pressure from the city transit agency.

title: The Pretender
label: Asylum Records
about: Jackson Browne's fourth album, produced by Jon Landau for Asylum. Made in the wake of his first wife's death, it reached No. 5 on the Billboard chart and was later certified triple platinum.

title: Battle Lines
label: Domino Records
about: The second album from electronic duo Bob Moses, issued by Domino three years after Days Gone By. It pushed their dance-oriented sound further toward rock, and critics gave it mixed reviews.

title: Victorious Visions - Dreams & Vibrations Instrumentals
label: Redefinition Records
about: An instrumental album by Damu the Fudgemunk on Redefinition Records built from his production for Dreams and Vibrations, his 2018 collaboration with rapper Flex Mathews. Rather than simply removing the vocals, he reworked the beats so the record could stand on its own.

title: A Whole New Thing
label: Sundazed Music
personnel: Sly Stone – vocals, organ, guitar, piano, celeste, harmonica
Little Sister (Vet Stone, Mary McCreary, Elva Mouton) – background vocals

tracks.t: Let Me Hear It From You

about: The first album by Sly and the Family Stone, produced by Sly Stone for Epic. It drew mixed reviews and failed to chart, prompting label head Clive Davis to ask for a more commercial approach, which led to Dance to the Music.

title: Autoamerican
label: Chrysalis Records
about: Blondie's fifth album, produced by Mike Chapman for Chrysalis and marked by wide stylistic experiments. It yielded two US chart-topping singles, the reggae cover The Tide Is High and the early rap crossover Rapture.

title: Jay & Kai + 6: The Jay And Kai Trombone Octet
label: Columbia Records
personnel: Urbie Green, Bob Alexander, Eddie Bert, Jimmy Cleveland, Tom Mitchell, Bart Varsalona – trombone

tracks.t: All At Once You Love Her
Surrey With The Fringe On Top
You Don't Know What Love Is
The Continental (You Kiss While You're Dancing)

about: A Columbia jazz album led by trombonists J. J. Johnson and Kai Winding, who fronted an octet of trombones plus a rhythm section. It was recorded in April 1956 with George Avakian producing and followed their earlier Trombone for Two.

title: Boy With Lots Of Brass
label: Mercury Records
about: A 1957 EmArcy big band record led by Canadian trumpeter Maynard Ferguson, with vocalist Irene Kral appearing on some tracks. It presents a dozen standards in charts written by arrangers including Al Cohn, Bill Holman, Willie Maiden and Ernie Wilkins.

artist: Dave McKenna Quartet Featuring Zoot Sims
title: Saxophone
label: Chiaroscuro Records
personnel: Zoot Sims – tenor saxophone, soprano saxophone
about: A Chiaroscuro Records session cut in New York in October 1974 and produced by Hank O'Neal. Pianist Dave McKenna leads a quartet with Zoot Sims on tenor and soprano sax, Major Holley on bass and Ray Mosca on drums.
artistKey: Dave McKenna Quartet Featuring Zoot Sims

title: Walk Softly / Run Wild!
label: Jasmine Records
about: An orchestral jazz LP issued by Coral in 1959 under arranger and composer Johnny Richards, best known for his writing for Stan Kenton. It showcases his big band arrangements, recorded in New York in 1959.

title: Boy
label: Island Records
personnel: The Edge – guitar, backing vocals, glockenspiel
about: The first full-length record by Irish rock band U2, issued by Island Records in 1980 and produced by Steve Lillywhite. Its songs deal with adolescence and growing up, and it includes the single I Will Follow.
cdNote: CD listed in your My CDs playlist

title: No Secrets
label: Elektra

tracks.t: His Friends Are More Than Fond Of Robin

about: Carly Simon's commercial breakthrough, produced by Richard Perry and recorded in London for Elektra. It held the top spot on the Billboard 200 for five weeks, and its lead single You're So Vain became a number-one hit in the US.

title: Scobey And Clancy
label: Good Time Jazz

tracks.t: When That Midnight Choo-Choo Leaves For Alabam'
Ain't Gonna Give You None Of My Jelly Roll
I Want To Go Back To Michigan (Down On The Farm)

about: A Dixieland LP on the Good Time Jazz label from trumpeter Bob Scobey's San Francisco band. Banjoist and singer Clancy Hayes handles vocals on most of its eleven tracks.

tracks.t: El Tonto En La Colina (The Fool On The Hill)
Sabor A Mi (Be True To Me)
Dream A Little Dream Of Me

title: Sign "O" The Times
label: Paisley Park Records
personnel: Prince – lead vocals and various instruments
Sheila E. – drums and percussion (10), percussion and rap

tracks.t: I Could Never Take The Place Of Your Man
It's Gonna Be A Beautiful Night

about: A double album by Prince, released by Paisley Park and Warner Bros. after he disbanded the Revolution. Drawing on funk, rock, soul and pop, it was built from several abandoned projects and is widely ranked among his finest work.

title: Rendezvous
label: Capitol Records

tracks.t: Thank You For A Lovely Evening

about: A Capitol LP of mood music featuring cornetist Bobby Hackett, with arrangements and conducting by Glenn Osser. It belongs to the series of lush, ballad-oriented records Hackett made for Capitol in the 1950s.

title: Color Me Barbra
label: Columbia Records

tracks.t: I've Grown Accustomed To Her Face
Let's Face The Music And Dance
Sam, You Made The Pants Too Long
I Stayed Too Long At The Fair

about: A Columbia album by Barbra Streisand tied to her first CBS television special broadcast in color. It reached number three in the US, went gold, and earned Grammy nominations, including Album of the Year.

title: No Count Sarah
label: Mercury Records
personnel: Wendell Culley, Thad Jones, Snooky Young & Joe Newman – trumpet
Henry Coker, Al Grey & Benny Powell – trombone
Marshal Royal, Frank Foster, Billy Mitchell, Charlie Fowlkes, Frank Wess – sax
about: A vocal jazz record by Sarah Vaughan, taped in New York in August 1957 and issued two years later on EmArcy. She is backed by members of the Count Basie band without Basie himself, hence the playful title.

title: Desolation Angels
label: Swan Song Records
personnel: Paul Rodgers – vocals, guitar, piano, synthesisers
about: The English hard rock group Bad Company released this on Swan Song, taking its title from a Jack Kerouac novel. Featuring the hit Rock 'n' Roll Fantasy, it climbed to number three in the US and was their final top-ten album.

title: Easy
label: Capitol Records

tracks.t: Make Me A Present Of You
When I Look In Your Eyes

about: A Capitol release by Nancy Wilson, arranged and conducted mainly by Jimmy Jones and produced by David Cavanaugh. It opens and closes with Jobim songs, made the top five of the R&B album chart, and includes the single Face It Girl, It's Over.

title: Ghost In The Machine
label: A&M Records
personnel: Sting – bass guitar, lead vocals, double bass, keyboards, saxophone
Andy Summers – guitar, backing vocals, keyboards

tracks.t: Every Little Thing She Does Is Magic
Hungry For You (J'Aurais Toujours Faim De Toi)

about: The Police's fourth record, made in Montserrat with producer Hugh Padgham, adds horns and synthesizers to the trio's sound. It topped the UK chart and produced hits such as Every Little Thing She Does Is Magic and Spirits in the Material World.

label: XL Recordings

tracks.t: Send My Love (To Your New Lover)

about: English singer Adele's third album, released by XL Recordings, reflects on nostalgia and regret. Led by the single Hello, it broke first-week sales records in the US and UK and won the Grammy for Album of the Year.

title: Joan Armatrading
label: A&M Records
personnel: Peter Wood – Hammond organ, piano, electric piano
about: Joan Armatrading's self-titled third album, produced by Glyn Johns and recorded in London for A&M. It reached number twelve in the UK, went gold, and contains her biggest-selling single, Love and Affection.

title: Heartbeat City
label: Elektra Records
about: The fifth album by Boston new wave band the Cars, co-produced with Robert John Mutt Lange and issued by Elektra. Its polished synth-pop sound yielded several hits, among them Drive, You Might Think and Magic.

title: Pretenders II
label: Sire Records
personnel: Chrissie Hynde – rhythm guitar, lead vocals
James Honeyman-Scott – lead guitar, keyboards, backing vocals
Pete Farndon – bass guitar, backing vocals
about: The Pretenders' second album, the last made by the original lineup before two members died. Produced by Chris Thomas, it includes songs such as Message of Love, Talk of the Town and I Go to Sleep.

title: Made In The Shade
label: Rolling Stones Records
personnel: Keith Richards – electric and acoustic guitars
Mick Taylor – electric, acoustic, bass and slide guitar
about: A greatest-hits set issued on the Rolling Stones' own label, gathering tracks from their early-1970s albums from Sticky Fingers through It's Only Rock 'n Roll. It was the band's first official compilation drawn from that era.

title: Songs From The Big Chair
label: Warner Bros Records

tracks.t: Everybody Wants To Rule The World

about: Tears for Fears' second album, produced by Chris Hughes, moved the duo toward a broader pop-rock sound. It reached number one in the US and produced the hits Shout, Everybody Wants to Rule the World and Head over Heels.
cdNote: CD listed in your My CDs playlist

title: Purple Rain
label: Warner Bros. Records
personnel: Lisa Coleman, Matt Fink – keyboards, vocals
about: Prince's sixth album and the first billed with his band the Revolution, serving as the soundtrack to the film of the same name. It spent months at number one in the US and contains When Doves Cry, Let's Go Crazy and the title song.

title: This Is How It Is
label: Traffic Entertainment Group
about: The first album by the hip hop group Original Flavor, released on Atlantic and produced by member Ski. It was recorded in Brooklyn and Manhattan in 1991 and 1992 and was followed by Beyond Flavor in 1994.

title: For Once In My Life
label: Liberty

tracks.t: For Once In My Life / After Today
Yesterday I Heard The Rain (Esta Tarde Vi Llover)
Come Rain Or Come Shine / This Girl's In Love With You
Can't Take My Eyes Off You
The Other Man's Grass Is Always Greener
Some Of These Days / After You've Gone

about: A 1969 Liberty Records LP by Vikki Carr, captured in concert and opening with a medley built around the Stevie Wonder hit that gives the record its name. The set mixes contemporary pop covers such as Happy Together with standards and Latin-tinged material.

title: John Barleycorn Must Die
label: United Artists Records
personnel: Steve Winwood – vocals, guitar, bass , organ, piano, electric piano
Jim Capaldi – drums, percussion, tambourine, vocals
Chris Wood – saxophone, flute, organ, percussion
about: Traffic's 1970 comeback record, which began as a Steve Winwood solo project before the band reconvened. Named after a traditional English folk song it adapts, it reached the top five in the United States, the group's best American chart showing, and earned a gold certification.

title: Beautiful Noise
label: Columbia Records
personnel: Richard Bennett, Robbie Robertson, Jesse Ed Davis – guitar
Larry Knechtel, Alan Lindgren, David Paich – piano
Dennis St. John, Jim Keltner, Russ Kunkel, Jim Gordon – drums
Garth Hudson – Hammond organ, Lowrey organ

tracks.t: If You Know What I Mean

about: Neil Diamond's 1976 Columbia album, produced by Robbie Robertson of The Band and pitched as a comeback. It reflects on his early songwriting days in New York, topped charts in several countries, reached number four in the US and went platinum there.

title: The Singles
label: Bikini Kill Records
about: A short Kill Rock Stars collection issued after Bikini Kill split, gathering three singles from 1993 and 1995. Joan Jett produced and played on the opening tracks, and critics responded warmly both on release and when it was reissued in 2018.

title: Pottymouth
label: Kill Rock Stars
about: Bratmobile's first full-length record, released on Kill Rock Stars and recorded mostly in Washington, DC in 1992. A raw, lo-fi punk set that includes a cover of the Runaways' Cherry Bomb, it is now regarded as a landmark of the riot grrrl movement.

title: Californication
label: Warner Bros. Records
personnel: John Frusciante – guitar, backing vocals, keyboards
Chad Smith – drums, shaker, cowbell, woodblock, tambourine
about: Produced by Rick Rubin, this Warner Bros. release marked guitarist John Frusciante's return and steered the Red Hot Chili Peppers toward a more melodic sound. Driven by singles like Scar Tissue and Otherside, it became their biggest seller, moving well over 15 million copies worldwide.

title: You Haunt Me
label: Cherrytree Records
about: The first full-length release from Los Angeles-area indie pop trio Sir Sly, self-produced and issued by Interscope in 2014. Its moody, electronic-leaning songs include the title single, which became an alternative radio hit for the band.

title: Channel Orange
label: Island Def Jam Music Group
personnel: Om'Mas Keith, Shea Taylor, Pharrell Williams – keyboards
André 3000, Taylor Johnson, John Mayer – guitars
about: Frank Ocean's first studio album, released by Def Jam in 2012 after his mixtape Nostalgia, Ultra. Widely acclaimed as one of the best records of its year, it debuted at number two in the US and won the Grammy for Best Urban Contemporary Album.

title: Hello, I Must Be Going!
label: Atlantic Records

tracks.t: Do You Know, Do You Care?
Don't Let Him Steal Your Heart Away

about: Phil Collins's second solo record, following Face Value and co-produced with Hugh Padgham. Its cover of You Can't Hurry Love topped the UK singles chart, and the album reached number two in Britain and went triple platinum in both the UK and US.

title: Tattoo You
label: Rolling Stones Records
about: A Rolling Stones album assembled largely from reworked outtakes dating back through the 1970s, finished with new vocals and overdubs. Led by the single Start Me Up, it spent weeks at number one in the US, the band's most recent chart-topper there, and its cover won a Grammy.

title: It's Uptown
label: Columbia Records
about: George Benson's second album and his first for Columbia, produced by John Hammond and recorded in early 1966 with a quartet featuring organist Lonnie Smith and baritone saxophonist Ronnie Cuber. The soul-jazz set also showcases Benson singing on a few tracks.

title: Murmur
label: I.R.S. Records
personnel: Bill Berry – drums, backing vocals, percussion, bass guitar, piano
Mike Mills – bass , backing vocals, piano, organ, acoustic guitar
about: R.E.M.'s first full-length album, issued by I.R.S. Records and produced by Mitch Easter and Don Dixon in North Carolina. Its murky, jangling sound won wide critical praise, including Rolling Stone's album of the year honor, and it later went gold.

title: Movin'
label: Capitol Records

tracks.t: On A Slow Boat To China

about: A 1959 Capitol LP marking Kay Starr's return to the label after her RCA Victor years. Produced by Dave Cavanaugh with a big band conducted by Van Alexander, it presents her as a swinging jazz-pop vocalist on travel-themed material.

title: Whipped Cream & Other Delights
label: A&M Records
about: A 1965 A&M release by Herb Alpert's Tijuana Brass, famed for its cover photo of a model draped in what appears to be whipped cream. It held the top spot on the US album chart for eight weeks, stayed on the chart for years and sold millions.

artist: Terry Snyder And The All Stars
title: Persuasive Percussion
label: Command
personnel: The Command All – Stars Primary Artist

tracks.t: I'm In The Mood For Love

about: A 1959 stereo showcase LP on Enoch Light's Command Records, played by studio musicians led by drummer Terry Snyder. Designed to show off ping-pong stereo effects, it topped Billboard's stereo album chart for months in 1960 and launched a series of follow-ups.
artistKey: Terry Snyder And The All Stars

title: Main Course
label: RSO Records
personnel: Maurice Gibb – bass, lead guitar, rhythm guitar, vocals
about: Produced by Arif Mardin, this RSO album moved the Bee Gees toward R&B, funk and disco and introduced Barry Gibb's falsetto in a prominent way. Featuring Jive Talkin' and Nights on Broadway, it revived the group's fortunes, especially in America.

title: Tap Root Manuscript
label: MCA Records

tracks.t: He Ain't Heavy... He's My Brother

about: Neil Diamond's 1970 Uni album, carried by his first chart-topping single, Cracklin' Rosie. Its second side is an extended African-inspired suite that anticipated later world-music experiments by Western pop artists, and the album eventually went platinum.

title: Spank Your Blank Blank
label: Parachute Records
personnel: Maurice Commander – conductor, electric piano, piano, producer
Martin L. Dumas, Jr. – backing vocals, rhythm guitar
about: The first album by Chicago disco and funk performer Morris Jefferson, issued in 1978 on Parachute Records. Its title track had come out as a single and reached the lower half of the Billboard R&B top 40.

title: Live Convention '80
label: Disco Wax Records
personnel: DJ Cool Clyde, DJ Lightnin Lance, the Hypnotizing 3, Lil Sha Rock, Grandmaster Caz, JDL, and Kay Gee (of the Cold Crush Brothers), Whipper Whip, Ruby Dee, and Grand Wizard Theodore (of the Fantastic Five Freaks), the Soul Sonic Force, and the Nice and Nasty Four

tracks.t: Only So Much Oil In The Ground
I Won't Leave Unless You Want Me To
(To Say The Least) You're The Most
It Can Never Be The Same

title: AM
label: Domino Records

tracks.t: Why'd You Only Call Me When You're High?

about: Arctic Monkeys' 2013 Domino release, produced by James Ford, which brought hip-hop and R&B rhythms into their rock sound. It debuted at number one in the UK, became their biggest US success, and won the Brit Award for British Album of the Year.

title: Roberta Flack Featuring Donny Hathaway
label: Atlantic Records
personnel: Ray Chew, Paul Griffin, Raymond Jones, Harry Whitaker – keyboards
Hubert Eaves III, Ronnie Foster, Ed Walsh – synthesizers
Stevie Wonder – keyboards, drums, backing vocals
Hiram Bullock, Reggie Lucas, Jeff Mironov, John Tropea – guitar
Eluriel "Tinker" Barfield, Basil Fearrington, Anthony Jackson – bass

tracks.t: Don't Make Me Wait Too Long

about: Planned as a second duet record, this Atlantic album became a Roberta Flack project with Donny Hathaway as guest after his death in 1979. It includes their duets Back Together Again and You Are My Heaven, earned a gold certification and revived Flack's commercial standing.

title: Get Close
label: Real Records

tracks.t: How Much Did You Get For Your Soul?

about: The Pretenders' 1986 album, made with several producers including Bob Clearmountain and Jimmy Iovine and leaning toward a funkier sound. It contains Don't Get Me Wrong and Hymn to Her and reached the UK top ten.

title: The Lemon Of Pink
label: Temporary Residence Limited
personnel: Paul de Jong – music, mastering, mixing

tracks.t: The Future, Wouldn't That Be Nice
A True Story Of A Story Of True Love

about: The second album by the Books, released on the German label Tomlab in 2003. It blends acoustic instruments with found sound and spoken-word samples, and it drew strong reviews, with Pitchfork placing it among the top records of its year.

title: Dream With Dean
label: Reprise Records

tracks.t: If You Were The Only Girl
Baby Won't You Please Come Home

about: An intimate small-combo record on Reprise, produced by Jimmy Bowen, with Dean Martin backed by a quartet led by pianist Ken Lane. It climbed to No. 15 on the Billboard 200, and his reworked version of its song Everybody Loves Somebody later topped the Hot 100.

title: Roberta Flack & Donny Hathaway
label: Atlantic Records
about: A duet project by Roberta Flack and Donny Hathaway issued by Atlantic and produced by Joel Dorn and Arif Mardin. Its single Where Is the Love reached the US top five and earned the pair a Grammy, while their take on You've Got a Friend was also a hit.

title: Contradiction
label: Mercury Records
personnel: Billy Beck – piano, Clavinet, Synthesizer, vocals
James "Diamond" Williams – drums, timbales, congas, cowbells, steel drums, temple blocks, vocals
Clarence "Satch" Satchell – flute, alto saxophone, tenor saxophone
Leroy "Sugarfoot" Bonner – guitars, harmonica, percussion, vocals
about: A self-produced funk record by the Ohio Players released on Mercury. It went to No. 1 on the Billboard soul albums chart and No. 12 on the main LP chart, helped by the R&B chart-topping single Who'd She Coo?.

title: Welcome To My World
label: Reprise Records
personnel: Jimmy Bowen – producer Bill Justis, Billy Strange, H.B

tracks.t: In The Chapel In The Moonlight
Release Me (And Let Me Love Again)
The Green, Green Grass Of Home

about: Dean Martin's second album of 1967, produced by Jimmy Bowen for Reprise and leaning toward country-flavoured pop. It peaked at No. 20 on the Billboard 200, and In the Chapel in the Moonlight led the Adult Contemporary chart.

title: Like Blue
label: MGM Records

tracks.t: (What Did I Do To Be So) Black And Blue
Between The Devil And The Deep Blue Sea
The Blue Subterranean (Why Are We So Afraid?)

about: An MGM LP pairing André Previn's piano with David Rose's orchestra in a set of songs built around the theme of the blues and the color blue. It was recorded at RCA Victor's Hollywood studios with Al Schmitt engineering.

title: Sinatra & Company
label: Reprise Records
personnel: Antônio Carlos Jobim – guitar, scat singing

tracks.t: Someone To Light Up My Life
Don't Ever Go Away (Por Causa De Voce)
One Note Samba (Samba De Uma Nota So)

about: A Reprise album issued around Frank Sinatra's brief retirement, collecting bossa nova sessions with Antonio Carlos Jobim arranged by Eumir Deodato alongside contemporary pop songs produced by Don Costa. The material was recorded in Hollywood between 1969 and 1970.

title: Drums Of Passion
label: Columbia Records

tracks.t: Odun De! Odun De! (Happy New Year)
Shango (Chant To The God Of Thunder)

about: Babatunde Olatunji's Columbia recording of Nigerian percussion and chant, cut in New York in 1959. Credited with bringing African music to a wide Western audience, it sold millions and was later added to the US National Recording Registry; its track Jin-go-lo-ba became his signature piece.

title: Business As Usual
label: Columbia Records
personnel: Greg Ham – flute, keyboards, saxophone, vocals

tracks.t: I Can See It In Your Eyes
People Just Love To Play With Words

about: Men at Work's first album, produced by Peter McIan and featuring the hits Who Can It Be Now? and Down Under. It topped the Australian chart for nine weeks and the US Billboard 200 for fifteen, and also reached No. 1 in Britain.

title: Selling England By The Pound
label: Charisma Records
personnel: Peter Gabriel – vocals, flute, oboe, percussion
Steve Hackett – electric guitar, nylon guitar
Michael Rutherford – 12-string guitar, bass, electric sitar
Phil Collins – drums, assorted percussion, vocals

tracks.t: I Know What I Like (In Your Wardrobe)
The Cinema Show / Aisle Of Plenty

about: A progressive rock album by Genesis recorded at Island Studios in London and released on Charisma. It reached No. 3 in the UK and yielded the band's first hit single, I Know What I Like (In Your Wardrobe).

title: The Very Best Of Martin Denny
label: United Artists Records

tracks.t: Hawaiian Wedding Song (Ke Kali Nei Aul)

about: A United Artists compilation of Martin Denny's exotica and easy-listening recordings. Its twelve tracks include his signature Quiet Village along with versions of Bali Ha'i, Ebb Tide and Tiny Bubbles.

title: I Never Loved A Man The Way I Love You
label: Atlantic Records

tracks.t: I Never Loved A Man (The Way I Love You)
Don't  Let Me Lose This Dream
Do Right Woman - Do Right Man

about: Aretha Franklin's first album for Atlantic, produced by Jerry Wexler, with sessions begun at FAME Studios in Muscle Shoals and finished in New York. Driven by her chart-topping version of Respect, it reached No. 2 on the Billboard 200 and No. 1 on the R&B list.

tracks.t: Between The Devil & The Deep Blue Sea

title: Night Music
label: Columbia Records

tracks.t: Have You Ever Had That Feelin'

about: The third album by Hawaiian duo Cecilio & Kapono and their last for Columbia. Produced with Bruce Botnick and Terry Powell, it features mostly original songs and guest players such as saxophonist Tom Scott.

title: Parsley, Sage, Rosemary And Thyme
label: Columbia Records

tracks.t: The Big Bright Green Pleasure Machine
Flowers Never Bend With The Rainfall
For Emily, Whenever I May Find Her
A Poem On The Underground Wall

about: A folk rock album by Simon & Garfunkel produced by Bob Johnston for Columbia. It includes Homeward Bound and Scarborough Fair/Canticle, peaked at No. 4 in the US and was later certified triple platinum.

title: Quiet Village
label: Liberty
personnel: Augie Colon – bongos, congas, bird calls

tracks.t: My Little Grass Shack In Kealakekua, Hawaii Cha Cha Cha

about: An exotica album by Martin Denny released on Liberty and produced by Si Waronker. Built around his hit arrangement of Quiet Village, it charted on both the mono and stereo Billboard album lists, reaching No. 12 in stereo.

title: The Story Of A Young Heart
label: Jive Records
personnel: Mike Score – lead vocals, keyboards, guitar
Frank Maudsley – bass guitar Paul Reynolds lead guitar

tracks.t: The Story Of A Young Heart
The More You Live, The More You Love

about: A Flock of Seagulls' third album, produced by Steve Lovell for Jive. It produced the singles The More You Live, the More You Love and Never Again (The Dancer), and peaked at No. 30 in the UK and No. 66 in the US.

title: Too Shy (Midnight Mix)
label: EMI America
about: An extended 12-inch version of Too Shy, the debut single by Kajagoogoo, produced by Nick Rhodes and Colin Thurston for EMI. The song reached No. 1 in the UK and several other countries and No. 5 on the US Hot 100.

title: Fancy Meeting You Here
label: RCA Victor

tracks.t: On A Slow Boat To China
You Came A Long Way From St. Louis
Love Won't Let You Get Away
Love Won't Let You Get Away

about: A travel-themed duet album by Bing Crosby and Rosemary Clooney on RCA Victor, arranged and conducted by Billy May. Sammy Cahn and Jimmy Van Heusen supplied new material and reworked lyrics for standards, making it an early concept record.

title: Sign "O" The Times Maxi-Single
label: Paisley Park Records

tracks.t: La, La, La, He, He, Hee (Highly Explosive)

about: The title song from Prince's 1987 album, issued by Paisley Park and Warner Bros. with La, La, La, He, He, Hee on the flip side. Its sparse track tackles AIDS, drugs, gang violence and nuclear fear, and it reached No. 3 in the US.

title: San Antonio Rose
label: Columbia Records

tracks.t: I'll Be There (If You Ever Want Me)
Don't You Ever Get Tired (Of Hurting Me)

about: A country duet album by Willie Nelson and Ray Price, produced by Nelson for Columbia and named after a Bob Wills classic Price had recorded earlier. It reached No. 3 on the country albums chart and was certified gold.

title: Guilty
label: Columbia Records
personnel: Cornell Dupree, George Terry, Pete Carr, Lee Rienour – guitar
about: A Columbia album written and produced largely by Barry Gibb with Albhy Galuten and Karl Richardson. It topped charts in the US, UK and elsewhere, spawned the No. 1 hit Woman in Love, and became Streisand's biggest-selling album worldwide.

title: The Garland Touch
label: Capitol Records

tracks.t: I Happen To Like New York
Happiness Is A Thing Called Joe
It's A Great Day For The Irish

about: Judy Garland's last studio album issued in her lifetime, released by Capitol. It combines six unreleased songs cut in London in 1960 with four previously issued tracks, and it charted in the Billboard top 40.

title: Aretha Live At Filmore West
label: Atlantic Records
personnel: Brenda Bryant, Margaret Branch, Pat Smith – backing vocals

tracks.t: Spirit In The Dark (Reprise With Ray Charles)

about: A concert album recorded over three nights in March 1971 at San Francisco's Fillmore West, with King Curtis and the Kingpins backing Aretha Franklin and a guest appearance by Ray Charles. It topped the R&B album chart and reached No. 7 on the Billboard 200.

title: Chicago V
label: Columbia Records
personnel: Peter Cetera – bass guitar, wah-wah bass, vocals
Danny Seraphine – drums, congas, antique bells
about: Produced by James William Guercio, this record became Chicago's first chart-topping album in the US, holding the No. 1 spot for nine weeks. Its numbering counts the earlier Carnegie Hall live set, and it yielded the hit single Saturday in the Park.

title: Blonde On Blonde
label: Columbia Records
personnel: Bob Dylan – vocals, guitar, harmonica, piano
Charlie McCoy – bass guitar, guitar, harmonica, trumpet

tracks.t: One Of Us Must Know (Sooner Or Later)
Most Likely You Go Your Way And I'll Go Mine
Sad Eyed Lady Of The Lowlands

about: Bob Dylan's double LP was cut with producer Bob Johnston, starting in New York and largely finished in Nashville sessions in early 1966. It rounded out his mid-sixties electric trilogy, reached the US top ten, and is often cited as one of rock's earliest double albums.
cdNote: CD listed in your My CDs playlist

title: C'est Chic
label: Atlantic Records
personnel: Bernard Edwards, Nile Rodgers – producer, conductor
Robert Sabino – clavinet, piano, electric piano
about: Chic's second LP on Atlantic was produced by Nile Rodgers and Bernard Edwards. Powered by the chart-topping Le Freak and the hit I Want Your Love, it peaked at No. 4 on the Billboard 200 and led the US R&B albums chart for eleven weeks.

title: Good Thing
label: Columbia Records

tracks.t: If It Feels Good (Then It Must Be)

about: Leon Bridges followed his retro-soul debut with this Columbia release, made with producers including Ricky Reed and Niles City Sound. It entered the Billboard 200 at No. 3, earned a Best R&B Album Grammy nomination, and its track Bet Ain't Worth the Hand won a Grammy.

title: Red Octopus
label: Grunt Records
personnel: Paul Kantner, Craig Chaquico – vocals, guitar
David Freiberg – bass, organ, synthesizer, keyboards
Pete Sears – bass, keyboards, piano, organ, clavinet

tracks.t: I Want To See Another World

about: Jefferson Starship's second record spent four nonconsecutive weeks atop the Billboard 200 and went double platinum. Its lead single Miracles, sung by Marty Balin, reached No. 3, and the album stands as the top seller by any Jefferson Airplane-related lineup.

title: Exotica Vol. III
label: Liberty Records
about: Released on Liberty Records, this third entry in Martin Denny's Exotica series continued his blend of lounge jazz, Latin and Polynesian-flavored percussion and bird-call effects. It climbed to No. 50 on the US albums chart.

title: Romantica
label: Liberty Records

tracks.t: Love, Your Magic Spell Is Everywhere

about: Romantica is a Liberty Records LP from bandleader Martin Denny, issued during his most productive period of exotica recordings. It presents his combo's lush, gentle instrumental style applied to a set of romantic material.

title: Inner Secrets
label: Columbia Records
personnel: Armando Peraza, Raul Rekow – percussion, backing vocals
about: Produced by Dennis Lambert and Brian Potter and recorded in Hollywood, Santana's tenth studio record moved toward a more straightforward rock sound than the band's earlier Latin fusion. It produced hit covers of Stormy and One Chain (Don't Make No Prison) and was certified gold.

title: Led Zeppelin II
label: Atlantic Records
personnel: John Paul Jones – bass guitar, organ, backing vocals
Jimmy Page – guitars, theremin, backing vocals

tracks.t: What Is And What Should Never Be
Living Loving Maid (She's Just A Woman)

about: Recorded across British and North American studios while the band toured, Led Zeppelin's second album was produced by Jimmy Page with engineer Eddie Kramer. It became their first No. 1 in both the UK and US, and the single Whole Lotta Love reached the US top five.

title: The Mix-Up
label: Capitol Records
personnel: Ad-Rock – guitars, producer, engineer, art direction
MCA – bass guitar and upright basses, producer, engineer, art direction
Mike D – drums, producer, engineer, art direction
about: The Beastie Boys' seventh studio album is made up entirely of instrumental tracks played by the group on live instruments. It earned them the Grammy Award for Best Pop Instrumental Album.

title: Saturday Night Fever (The Original Movie Sound Track)
label: RSO Records

tracks.t: Bee Gees How Deep Is Your Love
Bee Gees More Than A Woman
Yvonne Elliman If I Can't Have You
Walter Murphy A Fifth Of Beethoven
David Shire Night On Disco Mountain
Bee Gees You Should Be Dancing
KC & The Sunshine Band Boogie Shoes

about: This RSO double-LP soundtrack to the John Travolta film is dominated by Bee Gees songs alongside other disco acts. It topped the US chart for 24 weeks, has sold over 40 million copies worldwide, and is the only disco record to win the Grammy for Album of the Year.

title: Currents
label: Fiction Records
personnel: Kevin Parker – songwriting, performance, production, recording, mixing

tracks.t: The Less I Know The Better

about: Kevin Parker wrote, played, produced and mixed Tame Impala's third album, largely at his home studio in Fremantle. Shifting toward synth-pop, disco and R&B textures, it debuted at No. 1 in Australia and won ARIA awards including Album of the Year.

title: Face Value
label: Atlantic Records 081227953935
about: Phil Collins's first solo album, co-produced with Hugh Padgham, drew heavily on his divorce and was made during a break from Genesis. Led by In the Air Tonight, it reached No. 1 in the UK and the US top ten, selling millions.

title: Louder Than Bombs
label: Sire Records

tracks.t: You Just Haven't Earned It Yet, Baby
Please Please Please Let Me Get What I Want
This Night Has Opened My Eyes

about: Assembled for the American market and issued by Sire, this double compilation gathers Smiths singles, B-sides and other non-album tracks. Rough Trade released it in the UK a couple of months later, and it was certified gold in both countries.

title: Random Access Memories
label: Columbia Records
about: Daft Punk's final studio album, released by Columbia, leaned on live musicianship and guests such as Pharrell Williams, Nile Rodgers and Giorgio Moroder. It won Grammys for Album of the Year and Best Dance/Electronica Album, while Get Lucky took Record of the Year.

title: (The) Ventures In Space
label: Dolton Records
about: Issued on Dolton and produced by Bob Reisdorff, this surf instrumental record pursues a space-age theme with eerie effects. It was among the first albums on which the Ventures used Mosrite guitars, and it was later reissued by Pickwick with new artwork.

title: Politely!
label: Capitol Records

tracks.t: I'll Get By (As Long As I Have You)
On The Sunny Side Of The Street
East Of The Sun (And West Of The Moon)
I Never Knew (I Could Love Anybody Like I'm Loving You)

about: Keely Smith's second solo LP for Capitol pairs her vocals with Billy May's arrangements under producer Voyle Gilmore. Its twelve traditional pop and jazz tracks alternate between swinging numbers and slower ballads.

title: Sgt. Pepper's Lonely Hearts Club Band
label: Parlophone Records
personnel: John Lennon – vocals, guitars, organ, tambourine, maracas
Paul McCartney – vocals, bass, guitar, piano, organ; comb and tissue paper
George Harrison – vocals, guitar, sitar, tambura,harmonica, comb and tissue paper; handclaps, tambourine, maracas
Ringo Starr – drums, congas, tambourine, maracas, tubular bells, vocals harmonica, comb and tissue paper; final piano E chord

tracks.t: Sgt. Pepper's Lonely Hearts Club Band
With A Little Help From My Friends
Lucy In The Sky With Diamonds
Being For The Benefit Of Mr. Kite
Sgt. Pepper's Lonely Hearts Club Band (Reprise)

about: The Beatles' eighth studio album, produced by George Martin at EMI Studios, framed its songs around a fictional band. It held the UK top spot for 27 weeks, won four Grammys including Album of the Year, and has sold over 32 million copies.

title: The Wall
label: Pink Floyd Records
personnel: Roger Waters – vocals, bass , synthesizer, guitar
David Gilmour – vocals, guitars, bass, synthesizer, clavinet
Richard Wright – piano, organ, synthesizer, clavinet

tracks.t: Another Brick In The Wall Part 1
The Happiest Days Of Our Lives
Another Brick In The Wall Part 2
Another Brick In The Wall Part 3

about: Pink Floyd's double-LP rock opera traces Pink, an alienated rock star who walls himself off from the world. The last album with all four post-Barrett members, it led the US chart for 15 weeks and spawned the chart-topping Another Brick in the Wall, Part 2.

title: Be The Cowboy
label: Dead Oceans
about: Mitski's fifth album, released by Dead Oceans and produced with longtime collaborator Patrick Hyland, packs fourteen brief art-pop songs into about half an hour. Widely acclaimed, it was her first Billboard 200 entry and features the single Nobody.

title: The Slow Rush
label: Fiction Records
personnel: Kevin Parker – songwriting, performance, production, mixing, art concept
about: Kevin Parker's fourth Tame Impala album, which he produced himself, explores time and memory across twelve tracks. It entered the US chart at No. 3, topped the Australian chart, and won five ARIA awards including Album of the Year.

title: The Getaway
label: Warner Bros. Records
personnel: Josh Klinghoffer – guitars, backing vocals, piano
about: Red Hot Chili Peppers worked with producer Danger Mouse rather than longtime collaborator Rick Rubin on this Warner Bros. release. It debuted at No. 2 in the US and UK, included the single Dark Necessities, and was the last to feature guitarist Josh Klinghoffer.

title: Hold Space For Me
label: Mom + Pop

tracks.t: Ne Me Quitte Pas (Don't Leave Me)

about: Hold Space for Me is the first full-length album by Philadelphia-area artist Orion Sun, issued by Mom + Pop Music. Its intimate songs blend R&B, soul and lo-fi production, and it drew favorable notices from music press.

title: LCD Soundsystem
label: DFA Records
personnel: Tim Goldsworthy, Eric Broucek, Tyler Pope, Nancy Whang – other sounds
Patrick Mahoney, Mandy Coon – other sounds

tracks.t: Daft Punk Is Playing At My House
Never As Tired As When I'm Waking Up

about: First full-length record by James Murphy's dance-punk project, issued on DFA Records. It came packaged with a bonus disc gathering the group's earlier singles, including Losing My Edge, and earned Grammy nominations.

title: Belafonte At Carnegie Hall
label: RCA Victor

tracks.t: Cu Cu Ru Cu Cu Paloma

about: Concert recording of Harry Belafonte performing at New York's Carnegie Hall in 1959, released by RCA Victor as a double LP. It became one of his best-selling records and spent a long stretch on the Billboard album chart.

title: Only Your Picture
label: Burning Sounds Records
about: Album by the Jamaican reggae vocal duo the Maytones, originally issued in 1984 on the Vista Sounds label. It was later reissued on vinyl by Burning Sounds for Record Store Day 2018.

artist: Frank Sinatra, Dean Martin & Sammy Davis Jr.
title: The Rat Pack Live At The Sands
label: UMe

Dean Martin Medley: Volare (Nel Blu, Dipinto Di Blu)/An Evening In Roma

about: Archival concert recording of Frank Sinatra, Dean Martin and Sammy Davis Jr. performing together at the Sands Hotel in Las Vegas in 1963, mixing songs with comic stage banter. It was issued commercially decades after the show.
artistKey: Frank Sinatra, Dean Martin & Sammy Davis Jr.

title: The Dark Side Of The Moon
label: Pink Floyd Records
personnel: Nick Mason – drums, percussion, tape effects

tracks.t: The Great Gig In The Sky

about: Concept album by Pink Floyd exploring pressure, greed, mortality and mental illness, noted for its studio experimentation and seamless track flow. It stayed on the Billboard 200 for many years and is among the best-selling albums ever made.

title: Greatest Hits
label: Hollywood Records
personnel: Freddie Mercury – vocals, piano, guitar, organ, synthesizer, synth bass
Brian May – guitar, vocals, piano, synthesizer
Roger Taylor – drums, vocals, timpani, gong, triangle, chimes, bicycle bells, handclaps, woodblocks, tambourine, cowbell
about: First hits collection by Queen, gathering their chart singles from the 1970s up to 1980. It went on to become the best-selling album in United Kingdom chart history.

title: Helplessness Blues
label: Sub Pop Records
personnel: Robin Pecknold – vocals, guitar, piano, fiddle, mandolin, hammer dulcimer
Skyler Skjelset – guitar, mandolin, water harp
about: Second full-length release by the Seattle folk band Fleet Foxes, issued by Sub Pop and Bella Union. It features layered vocal harmonies and introspective lyrics by Robin Pecknold and received a Grammy nomination for Best Folk Album.

title: Big Brother & The Holding Company
label: Columbia Special Products
about: First studio album by the San Francisco psychedelic rock band fronted by Janis Joplin, recorded in Los Angeles in December 1966 and issued by Mainstream Records. Columbia later reissued it after the group's Monterey Pop breakthrough.

title: Evolution
label: Columbia Records
about: Fifth album by the American rock band Journey, produced by Roy Thomas Baker and the first to feature drummer Steve Smith. It included the hit single Lovin', Touchin', Squeezin' and sold several million copies in the United States.

title: Infinity
label: Columbia Records
personnel: Neal Schon – electric and acoustic guitars, backing vocals
Gregg Rolie – keyboards, backing and co-lead (2 & 3) vocals
Ross Valory – bass guitar, backing vocals
about: Fourth album by Journey and the first with Steve Perry as lead singer, marking a shift toward a more radio-friendly sound. Produced by Roy Thomas Baker, it yielded the singles Wheel in the Sky and Lights and went multi-platinum.

title: Lemonade
label: Columbia Records
about: Sixth studio album by Beyonce, launched alongside an hour-long film on HBO and dealing with infidelity, Black womanhood and healing. It blends R&B, rock, country and hip hop and won the Grammy for Best Urban Contemporary Album.

title: The Joshua Tree
label: Island Records
personnel: Bono (Paul David Hewson) – lead vocals, harmonica, guitars
The Edge (David Howell Evans) – guitars, backing vocals, piano

tracks.t: Where The Streets Have No Name
I Still Haven't Found What I'm Looking For

about: Fifth album by the Irish rock band U2, produced by Brian Eno and Daniel Lanois and shaped by the group's fascination with America. It topped charts worldwide, included With or Without You, and won the Grammy for Album of the Year.

title: 3rd Eye Vision
label: Fat Beats Records
personnel: Del the Funky Homosapien (Teren Delvon Jones)
about: First album credited to the Oakland hip hop collective Hieroglyphics as a full group, released on their own Hieroglyphics Imperium label. It features members such as Del the Funky Homosapien, Souls of Mischief and Casual.

title: Four Sides Of Melanie
label: Buddah Records

tracks.t: What Have They Done To My Song Ma

about: Double-LP compilation drawn from the late-1960s recordings of the singer-songwriter Melanie for the Buddah label, released in 1972 after she had become a major star.

title: Paul's Boutique
label: Capitol Records

tracks.t: Looking Down The Barrel Of A Gun

about: Second album by the Beastie Boys, made with the Dust Brothers and built from dense layers of samples. It sold poorly at first compared with their debut but has since been widely regarded as a landmark of hip hop production.

title: Bloom
label: Sub Pop
personnel: Victoria Legrand – vocals, keyboards, organ, piano
Alex Scally – guitar, basses, piano, organ and keyboards, backing vocals
about: Fourth album by the Baltimore dream pop duo Beach House, issued by Sub Pop and Bella Union. It continued the lush, atmospheric sound of its predecessor and became their highest-charting release at the time.

title: Buena Vista Social Club
label: World Circuit
about: Album recorded in Havana by veteran Cuban musicians assembled by Juan de Marcos Gonzalez and guitarist Ry Cooder, reviving son and bolero styles. It won a Grammy and became an international best-seller, inspiring a documentary film.

title: Seeds
label: Harvest
personnel: David Andrew Sitek – guitars, keyboards, loops
Kyp Malone – vocals, guitars, bass, loops
Jaleel Bunton – drums, bass, vocals, loops, guitars
about: Fifth album by the Brooklyn band TV on the Radio and their first after the death of bassist Gerard Smith. Released on Harvest Records, it leans toward more direct, upbeat songwriting.

title: No Geography
label: Virgin EMI Records
about: Ninth album by the British electronic duo the Chemical Brothers, made partly with vintage equipment from their early years. It won the Grammy for Best Dance/Electronic Album.

title: Oh, Inverted World
label: Sub Pop
personnel: James Mercer – vocals, guitars, keyboards, xylophone, autoharp, programming, harmonium, percussion, harmonica
about: First album by the indie rock band the Shins, released by Sub Pop and largely recorded by frontman James Mercer. Its song New Slang gained wide exposure through the 2004 film Garden State.

title: Second Line
label: Merge Records
about: Sixth album by the New Orleans singer Dawn Richard and her first on Merge Records, named after the city's parade tradition. It mixes electronic dance music, house and R&B and was well received by critics.

title: Oregon City Sessions
label: Approaching AIRballoons
about: Live-in-studio session recorded by Portugal. The Man in December 2008 in a suburb of Portland, Oregon, and shelved for more than a decade before its release in 2021.

title: Woodstock
label: Atlantic Records

tracks.t: Noise Pollution (Version A, Vocal Up Mix 1.3)

about: Eighth album by the Alaska-formed rock band Portugal. The Man, issued by Atlantic Records. It contains the hit single Feel It Still, which won a Grammy for Best Pop Duo/Group Performance.

title: Bitches Brew
label: Columbia Records
about: Double album by jazz trumpeter Miles Davis, recorded in August 1969 with a large ensemble and assembled through heavy tape editing by producer Teo Macero. It is a defining work of jazz fusion and became a gold-selling record.

title: Graceland
label: Legacy

tracks.t: Diamonds On The Soles Of Her Shoes
All Around The World Or The Myth Of Fingerprints

about: Seventh solo studio album by Paul Simon, recorded largely with South African musicians and blending their styles with American pop. It was a major commercial comeback and won the Grammy for Album of the Year, while also stirring controversy over the cultural boycott of apartheid South Africa.

title: Live At Fillmore West
label: ATCO Records
about: Concert album by saxophonist King Curtis and his band the Kingpins, recorded over three nights in March 1971 at San Francisco's Fillmore West, where they also backed Aretha Franklin. It came out on Atlantic shortly before Curtis was killed.

title: OK Computer
label: XL Recordings
personnel: Nigel Godrich – committing to tape, audio level balancing
Radiohead – committing to tape, music Thom Yorke, Jonny Greenwood, Phil Selway, Ed O'Brien, Colin Greenwood
about: Third album by the English band Radiohead, produced with Nigel Godrich and exploring themes of alienation and technology. It won the Grammy for Best Alternative Music Album and is frequently ranked among the greatest albums ever recorded.

title: The Look Of Love
label: Original Recordings Group

tracks.t: The Night We Called It A Day
I Get Along Without You Very Well

about: Sixth album by Canadian jazz pianist and singer Diana Krall, released by Verve and produced by Tommy LiPuma, featuring orchestral arrangements by Claus Ogerman. It topped the Canadian album chart.

title: The Queen Is Dead
label: Warner Music UK Ltd.
personnel: Johnny Marr – guitars, orchestration, synthesised strings, harmonium

tracks.t: The Queen Is Dead (Take Me Back To Dear Old Blighty) (Medley)
The Boy With The Thorn In His Side
There Is A Light That Never Goes Out
Some Girls Are Bigger Than Others

about: Third album by the Manchester band the Smiths, released by Rough Trade. It combines Morrissey's wry, melancholic lyrics with Johnny Marr's guitar work and is widely cited as one of the finest British rock records.
cdNote: CD listed in your My CDs playlist

title: Cuz I Love You
label: Atlantic
about: Lizzo's first album for a major label, issued through Nice Life and Atlantic. It blends pop, soul, funk and hip hop around themes of self-love and confidence, and its success, helped by the resurgent single Truth Hurts, made her a mainstream star and earned Grammy recognition.

title: Round Robin and Brimstone
label: Luv N' Haight
about: Self-titled soul and boogie LP by a group led by Robin Lloyd, who also fronted The Round Robin Monopoly. Original copies became expensive collector items, and the six-track record was reissued on vinyl by Luv N' Haight for Record Store Day Drops in 2021.

title: A New Light
label: RCA Victor

tracks.t: A Time For Us (Love Theme From "Romeo And Juliet")
The Heart Is A Lonely Hunter (If You Needed Me)

about: LP by the American vocal pop group The Match, issued by RCA Victor (LSP-4206) and recorded in Hollywood. It mixes sunshine pop and soft rock treatments of contemporary songs, including material by Simon & Garfunkel, Jimmy Webb, Bacharach and David, and the musical Hair.

title: Let It Bleed
label: ABKCO
personnel: Mick Jagger – vocals, harmonica, acoustic guitar
Keith Richards – electric, acoustic, slide & bass guitar, vocals
Mick Taylor – slide guitar, electric guitar

tracks.t: You Can't Always Get What You Want

about: Rolling Stones album recorded during the transition from Brian Jones to Mick Taylor, both of whom appear on a few tracks. Featuring Gimme Shelter and You Can't Always Get What You Want, it leans on blues and country influences and is widely ranked among the band's finest records.
cdNote: CD listed in your My CDs playlist

tracks.t: The Byrds Hey Joe (Where Ya Gonna Go)
John Davidson You Don't Have To Say You Love Me (Io Che Non Vivo Senza Te)
The New Christy Minstrels –These Boots Are Made For Walkin'
The Pozo-Seco Singers You've Lost That Lovin' Feelin'
Paul Revere & The Raiders Just Like Me
Billy Joe Royal Down In The Boondocks
Simon And Garfunkel We've Got A Groovey Thing Goin'

title: Led Zeppelin IV
label: Atlantic Records
personnel: John Paul Jones – bass, electric piano, mandolin, recorders, synthesizer
Jimmy Page – electric and acoustic guitars, mandolin
about: Untitled fourth album by Led Zeppelin, commonly named after its sequence number or the four symbols on its label. It contains Stairway to Heaven, Black Dog and Rock and Roll, became one of the best-selling albums ever, and is regarded as a landmark of hard rock.

title: Answers 2 Trouble
label: Permanent Vacation
about: Fourth full-length album by Frankfurt producer Phillip Lauer, released on Permanent Vacation. The nine-track record mixes house, synth-pop and Italo-disco flavours, and its lead single Altalenanti features Italian producer Fabrizio Mammarella.

title: Electric Music For The Mind And Body
label: Vanguard
personnel: Country Joe McDonald – lead vocals, rhythm guitar
Barry " The Fish" Melton – lead guitar, vocals
about: First album by the Berkeley band Country Joe and the Fish, released on Vanguard. Combining psychedelic rock, organ-driven jams and political satire, it became a key document of the San Francisco Bay Area sound of the late 1960s.

title: Ella Fitzgerald Sings The Gershwin Song Book Vol. 1
label: Verve Records

tracks.t: Nice Work If You Can Get It
Let's Call The Whole Thing Off

about: Large Verve project in which Ella Fitzgerald interprets dozens of songs by George and Ira Gershwin, arranged and conducted by Nelson Riddle. Originally spread over several LPs, it was part of her celebrated Song Book series dedicated to major American popular songwriters.

title: In Through The Out Door
label: Classic Records
personnel: John Paul Jones – bass guitar, keyboards
about: The last Led Zeppelin studio album issued before drummer John Bonham's death in 1980. Recorded in Stockholm, it gives a larger role to John Paul Jones's keyboards, and it reached number one in both the United Kingdom and the United States.

title: Crosby, Stills & Nash
label: Atlantic Records
personnel: Stephen Stills – vocals, guitars, bass, keyboards, percussion
about: Debut record by the trio of David Crosby, Stephen Stills and Graham Nash, issued by Atlantic. Known for its close vocal harmonies and songs such as Suite: Judy Blue Eyes and Marrakesh Express, it was a major commercial success and helped define folk rock at the end of the decade.

title: Wheels Of Fire
label: ATCO Records
personnel: Jack Bruce – vocals, bass , cello, harmonica, calliope, acoustic guitar, recorder
Ginger Baker – drums, percussion, bells, glockenspiel, timpani, vocals
Felix Pappalardi – viola, bells, organ, trumpet, tonette

tracks.t: Sitting On Top Of The World

about: Double album by Cream pairing one disc of studio recordings with one disc of concert performances, much of it captured at the Fillmore in San Francisco. It includes White Room and a long live Crossroads, and it topped the US chart.

title: Revolver
label: Parlophone
personnel: John Lennon – vocals, guitar, organ, Mellotron, harmonium
Paul McCartney – vocals, guitar, piano, clavichord
George Harrison – vocals; guitar, sitar, tambura
Ringo Starr – drums; tambourine, maracas, cowbell, shaker
about: Beatles album that pushed studio experimentation further, using tape loops, reversed sounds and Indian instrumentation. Songs range from Eleanor Rigby to Tomorrow Never Knows, and it is frequently cited among the most influential albums in popular music.

title: Dig Your Own Hole
label: Freestyle Dust

tracks.t: Get Up On It Like This

about: Second album by the English electronic duo The Chemical Brothers, featuring Block Rockin' Beats and Setting Sun with Noel Gallagher on vocals. It topped the UK chart and became a defining big beat record of the late 1990s.

title: Who's Next
label: MCA Records
personnel: John Entwistle – bass, brass, vocals, piano
Pete Townshend – guitar, VCS 3, organ, ARP synthesizer, vocals, piano
about: Album built from songs salvaged from Pete Townshend's abandoned Lifehouse project. Noted for its synthesizer textures on Baba O'Riley and Won't Get Fooled Again, it reached number one in the UK and is often named among the greatest rock albums.
cdNote: CD listed in your My CDs playlist

title: Wonderful Sarah
label: Mercury Records
about: Mercury LP (MG 20219) by jazz and pop singer Sarah Vaughan, gathering twelve songs such as Mr. Wonderful, Whatever Lola Wants and Old Devil Moon. Much of the material reflects the pop-oriented recordings she made for the label in the mid-1950s.

title: Brubeck On Campus
label: Columbia

tracks.t: I'm Afraid The Masquerade Is Over

about: Two-record Columbia set reissuing college concert performances by the Dave Brubeck Quartet with Paul Desmond, recorded in the early 1950s. Produced for reissue by Teo Macero, it includes pieces such as Balcony Rock, Le Souk and The Song Is You.

title: Thr!!!er
label: Warp Records
personnel: Allan Wilson – saxophone, keyboards, percussion, background vocals
about: Fifth album by the dance-punk band !!!, released on Warp and produced with Jim Eno of Spoon. It leans toward tighter disco and funk song structures and includes the single One Girl / One Boy.

title: All You Writers / Gonna Guetta Stomp
label: Warp Records
about: Single by the dance-punk band !!! combining two songs from their 2015 album As If, issued on Warp ahead of and around the album's release.

title: Shake The Shudder
label: Warp Records
personnel: Allan Wilson – saxophone, keyboards, percussion, background vocals
about: Seventh album by !!!, released on Warp, continuing the group's mix of dance-punk, house and disco. It features several guest vocalists, including Lea Lea, and singles such as The One 2.

title: Something Special
label: De-Lite Records
personnel: Clifford Adams, Michael Ray, Robert Mickens – Trumpet

tracks.t: Take My Heart (You Can Have It If You Want It)

about: Kool & the Gang album produced with Eumir Deodato during the group's commercial peak with singer James J.T. Taylor. It yielded hits including Get Down On It, Take My Heart and Steppin' Out, and it reached the top of the US R&B album chart.

title: What's Going On
label: Tamla

tracks.t: Inner City Blues (Make Me Wanna Holler)

about: Song cycle in which Marvin Gaye addresses war, poverty, drug abuse and environmental damage from the perspective of a returning Vietnam veteran. Self-produced for Tamla against early label resistance, it became a commercial success and is widely ranked among the greatest albums ever made.
cdNote: CD listed in your My CDs playlist

title: Exotic Percussion
label: Liberty Records

tracks.t: Softly, As In A Morning Sunrise
The Girl Friend Of The Whirling Dervish

about: Martin Denny album built around unusual percussion, combining jazz instrumentation with instruments such as Japanese shamisen and Burmese gongs. It is part of his exotica catalogue for Liberty and was later reissued on vinyl by Jackpot Records.

title: To The 5 Boroughs
label: Capitol Records
about: Beastie Boys album produced by the group themselves, drawing on old-school hip hop and serving as a tribute to New York City after the September 11 attacks. It debuted at number one in the US and includes the single Ch-Check It Out.

title: Exotica
label: Liberty Records
personnel: Augie Colon – bongos, congas, Latin effects, bird calls
about: First album by pianist Martin Denny, featuring a cover of Les Baxter's Quiet Village with bird calls and Polynesian percussion. Its success, especially after a stereo version, gave the exotica genre its name and made Denny its leading figure.

title: Wallop
label: Warp Records
personnel: Rafael Cohen – vocals, guitar, bass, keyboards
about: Eighth album by !!!, released on Warp, which broadens the band's dance-punk sound with elements of pop, house and electro. Singles included Off the Grid and Serbia Drums.

title: Gershwin '79
label: Parachute Records

tracks.t: Medley: The Man I Love / Embraceable You
Medley: I Got Rhythm / Fascinating Rhythm

about: Disco album by a one-off studio ensemble that recasts George and Ira Gershwin standards, including Rhapsody in Blue and I Got Rhythm, as extended dance medleys. Produced by drummer Ross Salomone, it features Los Angeles session players such as Jerry Hey.

title: Rose In The Dark
label: Forever Living Originals
about: The first full-length album by London singer Cleo Sol, issued on Forever Living Originals and produced by her husband Inflo. Its eleven songs blend soul and gospel-tinged R&B, and several critics placed it on their lists of the best records of 2020.

title: O.S.T.
label: Piecelock 70
about: The third album by Los Angeles hip hop duo People Under the Stairs, released on Om Records. Built partly from records the pair bought on a European tour, it marked their first use of live instruments and includes Acid Raindrops, which became a fan favorite.

title: Demon Days
label: Not On Label (Gorillaz)
personnel: Damon Albarn – vocals, keyboards, acoustic guitar, synthesizers, melodica
Danger Mouse – percussion, drum programming, sampled loops
Jason Cox – bass guitar, additional guitars, drums, drum programming

tracks.t: Every Planet We Reach Is Dead
Fire Coming Out Of The Monkey's Head

about: Gorillaz's second album, made mainly with producer Danger Mouse and released by Parlophone and Virgin. It reached number one in the UK, sold roughly eight million copies worldwide, and spawned singles such as Feel Good Inc., which earned a Grammy award.

title: Black Pumas
label: ATO Records
personnel: Adrian Quesada – guitar, producer, engineering, mixing

tracks.t: Ain't No Love In The Heart Of The City

about: The self-titled first album by Austin psychedelic soul duo Black Pumas, released by ATO Records and produced by Adrian Quesada with Jon Kaplan. A deluxe version was nominated for Album of the Year at the Grammys, and the single Colors also drew major nominations.

title: Christmas Songs
label: Epitaph

tracks.t: Angels We Have Heard On High

about: A short holiday release from punk band Bad Religion on Epitaph, featuring punk arrangements of traditional carols plus a remix of American Jesus. Part of the proceeds went to a support network for survivors of clergy abuse, and it reached the US holiday album chart.

title: Summertime: Willie Nelson Sings Gershwin
label: Legacy

tracks.t: Lets Call The Whole Thing Off
They Can't Take That Away From Me

about: Willie Nelson recorded these George and Ira Gershwin standards after receiving the Library of Congress Gershwin Prize. Produced by Buddy Cannon and Matt Rollings, it features duets with Cyndi Lauper and Sheryl Crow and won the Grammy for Best Traditional Pop Vocal Album.

tracks.t: On Your WAy To The Ground

title: Takes Off
label: RCA Records
about: The first album by San Francisco band Jefferson Airplane, released on RCA Victor before Grace Slick joined, with Signe Toly Anderson singing. RCA pushed for lyric edits on some songs, so early pressings differ, and initial sales were modest.

title: Butts Band
label: Blue Thumb Records
about: The first record by Butts Band, formed by former Doors members Robby Krieger and John Densmore with singer Jess Roden. Produced by Bruce Botnick for Blue Thumb, it offers rock with reggae touches; the band changed lineup entirely before its second album.

title: Genius + Soul = Jazz
label: Impulse!

tracks.t: I'm Gonna Move To The Outskirts Of Town

about: An Impulse! album on which Ray Charles plays Hammond organ in front of big bands drawn from Count Basie players, with arrangements by Quincy Jones and Ralph Burns. It climbed to number four on the Billboard album chart and later entered the Grammy Hall of Fame.

title: Handful Of Soul
label: Smash Records

tracks.t: When A Man Loves A Woman

about: An all-instrumental James Brown album released on Smash Records, with Brown playing organ over a band arranged by saxophonist Nat Jones. It was recorded during 1966 in New York and Charlotte, and its version of Let's Go Get Stoned was issued as a single.

title: Some Girls
label: Rolling Stones Records
personnel: Mick Jagger – vocals, electric guitar, piano, percussion
Keith Richards – electric guitar, vocals, acoustic guitar, bass guitar, piano
Ronnie Wood – electric guitar, vocals, pedal steel, acoustic guitar, bass

tracks.t: Just My Imagination (Running Away With Me)

about: The Rolling Stones recorded this album in Paris, the first with Ronnie Wood as a full member. It reflects punk and disco influences, topped the US chart, became their best-selling US album, and produced hits including Miss You and Beast of Burden.

title: Book Of Dreams
label: Edsel Records
personnel: Steve Miller – vocals, guitar, synthesizer, sitar, producer
about: The Steve Miller Band's follow-up to Fly Like an Eagle, drawn largely from the same mid-1970s sessions in San Francisco. Released by Capitol, it reached number two in the US, went triple platinum, and included the singles Jet Airliner, Jungle Love and Swingtown.

title: The Score
label: Ruffhouse Records
personnel: Diamond D, DJ Red Alert, Omega, Pacewon, Rah Digga, Young Zee – vocals
about: The second and last album by the Fugees, issued by Ruffhouse and Columbia. Featuring Killing Me Softly and Ready or Not, it topped the US chart, sold around 22 million copies, and won the Grammy for Best Rap Album.

title: Band On The Run
label: Apple Records
personnel: Paul McCartney – vocals; bass, guitar; piano, keyboards; drums, percussion
Linda McCartney – harmony and backing vocals; organ, keyboards
Denny Laine – vocals; acoustic and electric guitars; percussion
about: The third Wings album, recorded largely in Lagos, Nigeria, after two members quit, leaving Paul and Linda McCartney with Denny Laine. Driven by the hits Jet and the title track, it became a major seller in 1974 and entered the Grammy Hall of Fame.

title: Coming Home
label: Columbia
personnel: Austin Jenkins – electric guitar, acoustic guitar, bass
Jeff Dazey – saxophone, piano, baritone saxophone, tenor saxophone
about: Leon Bridges' first album, released on Columbia and produced by the Niles City Sound team in Fort Worth. Its retro soul style drew comparisons to 1960s records; it reached number six in the US, went platinum, and earned a Grammy nomination for Best R&B Album.

tracks.t: Back Road Roll With The Punches
Tommy Tutone What's It Gonna Do For You

title: The Live Mix Part 2
label: Stones Throw Records
personnel: Miles Tackett ("Musicman") – vocals, bass, cello, guitar
about: The second Live Mix release from Los Angeles funk ensemble Breakestra, led by Miles Tackett and issued by Stones Throw. The band plays a continuous run of classic funk and soul breaks on real instruments, and reviewers in Billboard and AllMusic responded positively.

title: H2O
label: RCA Records
personnel: Daryl Hall – vocals, guitar, keyboards, synthesizers
John Oates – vocals, guitar, electric piano, Roland CR-78 drum machine G.E
about: The eleventh album from Daryl Hall and John Oates, recorded at Electric Lady Studios and released by RCA. It reached number three in the US, their best album chart placing, and contained Maneater, which held the top spot of the Hot 100 for four weeks.

title: Private Eyes
label: RCA Records
personnel: Daryl Hall – vocals, keyboards, synthesizers, mando-guitar, mandocello, mandolin, mandola, vibraphone, timbales, Roland CR-78 drum machine
John Oates – vocals, guitar, mando-guitar, keyboards
Smith, Ray Gomez, Jeff Southworth – guitar
Mickey Curry, Jerry Marotta, Chuck Burgi – drums
about: The tenth album by Daryl Hall and John Oates, self-produced with Neil Kernon for RCA. It gave the duo two US number one singles, the title song and I Can't Go for That (No Can Do), and reached the top five of the Billboard 200.

title: Afro Roots
label: Prestige Records
about: A double-LP reissue gathering two late-1950s Fantasy albums by Cuban percussionist Mongo Santamaria, Yambu and Mongo. The material leans toward traditional Afro-Cuban rhythms and early Latin jazz, and includes the first recording of his composition Afro Blue.

title: The Trinity Session
label: RCA Records

tracks.t: I'm So Lonesome I Could Cry

about: Cowboy Junkies cut this second album in one day inside a Toronto church, gathered around a single microphone. First issued in Canada and then globally by RCA, it mixes originals with slowed covers such as Sweet Jane and became their breakthrough.

title: Hot On The Tracks
label: Motown Records

tracks.t: Girl, I Think The World About You
Just To Be Close To You

about: The Commodores' fourth Motown album, produced with James Anthony Carmichael. It was their first to top the US R&B album chart and features the Lionel Richie ballad Just to Be Close to You, which also became a pop top ten hit.

title: Left My Blues In San Francisco
label: Chess Records
personnel: Buddy Guy – lead guitar & lead vocals

tracks.t: She Suits Me To A Tee

about: Buddy Guy's first album, released by Chess and assembled from sessions dating from 1962 to 1967 with producer Gene Barge. It pairs older blues material with a few Guy originals, adding horns and arrangements partly by Charles Stepney.

title: A Josh White Program
label: Warner Bros Records

tracks.t: I'm Gonna Move To The Outskirts Of Town
He Never Said A Mumblin' Word
I Want You And I Need You

about: A 1954 collection by folk and blues singer and guitarist Josh White, presenting a program of his songs. Detailed release information is sparse, and it is generally catalogued as a compilation.

title: Exile On Main St.
label: Rolling Stones Records
personnel: Mick Jagger – vocals; harmonica; electric guitar
Keith Richards – guitars, backing vocals; bass guitar; electric piano

tracks.t: I Just Want To See His Face

about: A double album by the Rolling Stones, much of it recorded in a villa in the south of France while the band lived abroad for tax reasons. It topped charts in the UK and US, includes Tumbling Dice, and is widely ranked among the greatest rock albums.

title: Rare Stamps
label: Stax Records

tracks.t: You Can't Get Away From It
Just The One (I've Been Looking For)
I've Got To Love Somebody's Baby
If I Had To Do It All Over

about: A Stax collection of earlier singles by soul and blues vocalist Johnnie Taylor, gathering material recorded for the label before his breakthrough with Who's Making Love.

title: Europe '72
label: Warner Bros. Records
about: A triple live album drawn from the Grateful Dead's spring 1972 European tour, issued by Warner Bros. Several new songs debuted on it, including Jack Straw and Brown-Eyed Women, and it became one of the band's best-selling releases.
cdNote: CD listed in your My CDs playlist

title: Cosmic Thing
label: Reprise Records
personnel: Keith Strickland – guitars, keyboards, backing vocals
about: The B-52's fifth album and the first after guitarist Ricky Wilson's death, produced by Nile Rodgers and Don Was for Reprise. Fueled by Love Shack and Roam, it became the group's biggest commercial success.

title: Black Moses
label: Enterprise
personnel: Isaac Hayes – vocals, piano, vibraphone, organ, electric piano The Isaac Hayes Movement

tracks.t: (They Long To Be) Close To You
Nothing Takes The Place Of You
Medley: Ike's Rap II / Help Me Love
Medley: Ike's Rap III / Your Love Is So Doggone Good
I'll Never Fall In Love Again
Medley: Ike's Rap IV / A Brand New Me

about: A double album by Isaac Hayes on Stax's Enterprise imprint, issued soon after his Shaft soundtrack. It consists mostly of lengthy, orchestral reworkings of songs by other writers, and its fold-out cover depicting Hayes in robes became well known.

title: L.A. Woman
label: Elektra Records
personnel: Ray Manzarek – keyboards, rhythm guitar, Rhodes piano

tracks.t: The WASP (Texas Radio And The Big Beat)

about: The sixth studio album by the Doors, issued by Elektra and co-produced by the band with Bruce Botnick. It returned the group to a blues-rock sound, yielded the singles Love Her Madly and Riders on the Storm, and was the final record released while Jim Morrison was alive.
cdNote: CD listed in your My CDs playlist

title: Led Zeppelin
label: Atlantic Records
personnel: Jimmy Page – electric, acoustic and pedal steel guitars, backing vocal
John Paul Jones – bass, organ, backing vocal
John Bonham – drums, timpani, backing vocal
about: The first album by the English rock band Led Zeppelin, released in the US in January 1969 and in the UK that March. Often called Led Zeppelin I, it set out the heavy blues-based rock style that the group would become famous for.

title: Portrait
label: Bell Records
about: The fifth album by the vocal group the 5th Dimension and their first for Bell Records, produced by Bones Howe in Hollywood. Boosted by the hit One Less Bell to Answer, it climbed to number 20 on the Billboard albums chart.

title: The Big Chill (Original Motion Picture Soundtrack)
label: Motown

tracks.t: Marvin Gaye: I Heard It Through The Grapevine
Smokey Robinson & The Miracles: The Tracks Of My Tears
Three Dog Night: Joy To The World
The Temptations: Ain't Too Proud To Beg
Aretha Franklin: (You Make Me Feel Like A) Natural Woman
Smokey Robinson & The Miracles: I Second That Emotion
Procol Harum: A Whiter Shade Of Pale

about: A various-artists soundtrack to the 1983 Lawrence Kasdan film The Big Chill, released by Motown. It gathers 1960s soul and rock hits heard in the movie, from acts such as Marvin Gaye, the Temptations and Aretha Franklin, and became a long-running commercial success.

title: Empty Bed Blues
label: Elektra Records

tracks.t: His Eye Is On The Sparrow

about: An LP by folk and blues singer and guitarist Josh White, issued by Elektra in early 1962 with Jac Holzman as producer. It was released in mono and stereo editions in the US and also appeared on labels in France and the UK.

title: The Beat
label: Columbia Records
personnel: Paul Collins – rhythm guitar, lead vocals
Larry Whitman – lead guitar, third vocals
about: The first album by the Los Angeles power pop band the Beat, fronted by Paul Collins, who wrote nearly all of its twelve songs. Bruce Botnick produced it in Hollywood studios for Columbia, and critics generally received it well.

title: Thriller
label: Epic
about: Michael Jackson's sixth studio album, released by Epic and produced with Quincy Jones. It spawned a string of hit singles including Billie Jean, Beat It and the title track, and it is widely cited as the best-selling album in history.

title: The Hunter
label: Chrysalis Records

tracks.t: (Can I) Find The Right Words (To Say)
The Hunter Gets Captured By The Game

about: Blondie's sixth studio album, produced by Mike Chapman and recorded at the Hit Factory in New York for Chrysalis. It reached the UK top ten but was seen as a commercial and critical letdown, and the band issued no further new music until 1999.

title: Open Up The Door
label: Liberty

tracks.t: All The Best People Do It

about: The third and last studio album by the Glasgow folk duo the Humblebums, featuring Billy Connolly and Gerry Rafferty. It came out on Transatlantic Records in 1970, shortly before the pair split to pursue separate careers.

title: Welcome To The Pleasuredome
label: Island Records

tracks.t: Two Tribes (For The Victims Of Ravishment)

about: The first album by Liverpool band Frankie Goes to Hollywood, originally a double LP on ZTT produced by Trevor Horn. It collected hits such as Relax and Two Tribes, went to number one in the UK and earned triple platinum certification there.
cdNote: CD listed in your My CDs playlist

title: Baby Grand
label: Arista Records
about: The self-titled first LP by Philadelphia band Baby Grand, issued by Arista and produced by Rick Chertoff and Rob Hyman. The group included Hyman and Eric Bazilian, who later formed the Hooters; Billboard flagged the record as a top album pick in late 1977.

title: City Of Angels
label: Tamla
personnel: Billy Griffin – lead vocals, guitar, co-composer
Pete Moore – backing vocals, producer, co-composer
about: A concept album by the Miracles on Motown's Tamla label, written by Billy Griffin and Pete Moore and produced by Freddie Perren and Moore. It follows a man chasing a former girlfriend to Los Angeles, and its single Love Machine became a number one pop hit.

title: License To Dream
label: Atlantic Records

tracks.t: Where Would I Be (Without Your Love)

about: The third album by New York funk band Kleeer, released by Atlantic Records. It reached number 13 on the Billboard soul albums chart, helped by the single Get Tough, which was a top five dance hit.

title: East Bay Grease
label: San Francisco Records
personnel: Stephen "Doc" Kupka – baritone saxophone, background vocals
Skip Mesquite – tenor saxophone, flute, vocals

tracks.t: The Skunk, The Goose, And The Fly

about: The first album by the Oakland soul and funk group Tower of Power, produced by David Rubinson and recorded in San Francisco. It introduced the band's horn-driven sound before they moved to Warner Bros. for Bump City.

title: The Age Of Aquarius
label: Soul City

tracks.t: Medley: Aquarius/Let The Sunshine In (The Flesh Failures)
Don'tcha Hear Me Callin' To Ya

about: The fourth studio album by the 5th Dimension, produced by Bones Howe for Soul City. Its medley Aquarius/Let the Sunshine In won the Grammy for Record of the Year, and the album peaked at number two in the US and went gold.

title: Let's Take It To The Stage
label: Westbound Records
personnel: 'Cool' Cal Simon, 'Bad Bosco' Bernie Worrell, C 'Boogie' Mosson, Garry 'Dowop' Shider, 'Sting' Ray Davis, 'Shady' Grady Thomas, Clarence "Fuzzy" Haskins – vocals
Eddie Hazel, Michael Hampton, Garry Shider – guitar

tracks.t: Let's Take It To The Stage
Get Off Your Ass And Jam
Baby I Owe You Something Good

about: The seventh studio album by Funkadelic, produced by George Clinton and released on Westbound. A funk rock record full of humor and jabs at rival acts, it reached number 14 on the Billboard R&B albums chart.

title: Stardust
label: Columbia Records

tracks.t: On The Sunny Side Of The Street

about: A collection of ten pop standards recorded by Willie Nelson with producer Booker T. Jones for Columbia. Despite label doubts, it topped the country albums chart, stayed on the charts for years and was eventually certified five times platinum.

title: Shaft
label: Enterprise Records
personnel: Isaac Hayes – Lead vocals, keyboards, and lyrics
The Bar-Kays, The Isaac Hayes Movement – backing band
about: Isaac Hayes's double-LP score for the 1971 MGM film Shaft, issued on Stax's Enterprise label. Mostly instrumental, it topped the Billboard 200, and its title theme reached number one and won an Academy Award; it was later added to the National Recording Registry.

title: Easter
label: Arista Records
personnel: Lenny Kaye – guitar, bass guitar, vocals
Ivan Král – bass guitar, vocals, guitar
about: The third studio album by Patti Smith and the second credited to the Patti Smith Group, produced by Jimmy Iovine for Arista. It was her commercial breakthrough, driven by the single Because the Night, co-written with Bruce Springsteen.

title: Shades Of Blue
label: Sunset Records

tracks.t: Billie Holiday:  Be Fair To Me Baby
Billie Holiday:  Blue Turning Grey Over YouB2
Al Hibbler:  I Surrender Dear Al Hibbler:  I Got It Bad And That Ain't Good
Al Hibbler:  Don't Take Your Love From Me

about: A 1968 budget LP on the Sunset label that splits its sides between earlier recordings by jazz singer Billie Holiday and baritone Al Hibbler. Holiday sings songs such as Detour Ahead and Rocky Mountain Blues, while Hibbler covers standards like I Got It Bad and That Ain't Good.

title: Legend
label: ABC Records
personnel: Rusty Young – steel guitar, guitars, vocals
about: Poco's eleventh studio album, a country rock record produced by Richard Sanford Orshoff for ABC. It reached number 14 on the Billboard 200 and went gold, supported by the hits Crazy Love and Heart of the Night.

title: Double Trouble
label: Charlie's Records
about: An album by Montserrat soca singer Arrow, released shortly before his international breakthrough with Hot Hot Hot. Wikipedia lists it among his early-1980s releases.

title: Freedom At Point Zero
label: Grunt Records
personnel: Mickey Thomas – lead and backing vocals
Paul Kantner – lead and backing vocals, rhythm guitar, keyboards
Pete Sears – bass, piano, electric piano, organ, rhythm guitar
about: The fifth studio album by Jefferson Starship and the first with singer Mickey Thomas after the departures of Grace Slick and Marty Balin. Produced by Ron Nevison for Grunt, it took the band toward harder rock and featured the hit Jane.

title: Chicago III
label: Columbia Records

tracks.t: A Hard Risin' Morning Without Breakfast
When All The Laughter Dies In Sorrow

about: The third studio album by the rock band Chicago, another double LP produced by James William Guercio for Columbia. It climbed to number two on the Billboard 200 and was later certified platinum in the US.

title: Year Of The Cat
label: Janus Records

tracks.t: If It Doesn't Come Naturally, Leave It
