title: The Swing
label: ATCO Records
about: INXS's fourth studio album, produced by Nick Launay and Nile Rodgers and released in March 1984. It spent five weeks at number one in Australia and included the single Original Sin.

title: So
label: Geffen Records
personnel: Peter Gabriel – vocals, CMI, synthesizer, piano, LinnSequencer
Daniel Lanois – guitar, tambourine, surf guitar, twelve-string guitar
about: Peter Gabriel's fifth studio album, released in May 1986. Combining art rock with soul and African and Brazilian influences, it became his best-selling solo work, and its single Sledgehammer reached number one in the US.

title: Transatlanticism
label: Barsuk Records
about: The fourth studio album by indie rock band Death Cab for Cutie, released on Barsuk in October 2003. It was their last independent-label record before they moved to a major label.

title: Legend
label: Island Records
about: A posthumous greatest-hits collection of Bob Marley and the Wailers, issued by Island in 1984. It became one of the best-selling reggae records ever and has remained on charts for decades.

title: Midnight Love
label: Columbia
personnel: Marvin Gaye – vocals, Fender Rhodes piano, synthesizer, organ, drums, drum machine, drum programming, bells, glockenspiel, vibraphone, finger cymbals, bongos, congas, and cabasas
Gordon Banks – guitar, bass, vocals, drums
about: Marvin Gaye's first album for Columbia after leaving Motown, made largely in Belgium with heavy use of synthesizers and drum machines. It contains the hit Sexual Healing, which earned him Grammy awards, and it was the last album he released before his death in 1984.

title: Greatest Hits
label: United Artists Records
personnel: Papa Dee Allen, Harold Brown, B.B. Dickerson, Lonnie Jordan, Charles Miller, Lee Oskar, Howard Scott
about: A 1976 hits collection by the Los Angeles funk band War, gathering their best-known singles. It also introduced the new song Summer, which became a hit.

title: Solid Ground
label: Record Kicks
personnel: Kevin O'Dea – guitar, tambourine, cabasa, hand claps, vocals
Aaron Julin – organ, piano, synthesizer, trombone, tambourine, guiro, vocals

tracks.t: Bold Soul Sister, Bold Soul Brother

about: The first full-length record by the Grease Traps, a deep funk and soul group from Oakland, California, released by Record Kicks. Its eleven tracks were cut at studios in San Francisco and Oakland, and the singles Bird of Paradise and More and More preceded it on 45.

title: Eliminator
label: Warner Bros. Records

tracks.t: If I Could Only Flag Her Down

about: The eighth studio record by Texas trio ZZ Top, issued by Warner Bros. in March 1983. It became the group's biggest seller, with around 11 million copies sold and diamond status in the United States.

title: Legalize It
label: Columbia
personnel: Rita Marley, Judy Mowatt, Bunny Wailer – background vocals
about: Peter Tosh's first solo studio record, self-produced in Kingston and put out by Virgin and Columbia in 1976. The reggae set campaigns for cannabis legalisation, and the banning of its title song in Jamaica ended up boosting his international profile. It was later certified platinum in the US.

title: Star Wars: The Story Of Return Of The Jedi
label: Buena Vista Records

tracks.t: The Story Of Return Of The Jedi (Part 1)
The Story Of Return Of The Jedi (Part 2)

about: An abridged audio retelling of Return of the Jedi produced by Walt Disney's Buena Vista Records. Narrated by Chuck Riley, it combines dialogue, sound effects and John Williams' score from the 1983 film to tell the story for home listeners.

title: Soultrane
label: Original Jazz Classics

tracks.t: I Want To Talk About You

about: A Prestige album led by saxophonist John Coltrane, recorded in a single session on February 7, 1958. Backed by Red Garland, Paul Chambers and Art Taylor, he plays standards and ballads in the rapid, densely packed style later dubbed sheets of sound.

title: Del Jones' Positive Vibes
label: Hikeka Records
personnel: Benny R. Mitchell – bass, directed by

tracks.t: Times Are Hard Friends Are Few

about: A funk and jazz record by Philadelphia bandleader Del Jones and his group Positive Vibes, privately pressed in about 2,500 copies on his own Hikeka label. It revisits material from his rawer Court Is Closed with more polished arrangements and was later reissued by Now-Again Records.

title: The Keyboard King At Studio One
label: Soul Jazz Records
about: A 2000 anthology gathering recordings Jamaican keyboardist Jackie Mittoo made at Studio One. It was issued on CD and vinyl through Soul Jazz Records and its Universal Sound imprint.

title: Electric Ladyland
label: Reprise Records
personnel: Jimi Hendrix – vocals, guitars, piano, percussion, electric harpsichord, bass
Noel Redding – backing vocals, bass, acoustic guitar
Mitch Mitchell – backing vocals, drums, percussion

tracks.t: Have You Ever Been (To Electric Ladyland)
1983... (A Merman I Should Turn To Be)
Moon, Turn The Tides... Gently Gently Away

about: The third and last studio set by the Jimi Hendrix Experience, a double album that Reprise released in the US in October 1968, with Track's UK edition following shortly after.

title: Dirty Honey
label: Dirt Records
about: The first full-length studio album by Los Angeles hard rock band Dirty Honey, released in April 2021. It followed the group's self-titled 2019 EP.

title: Cosmic Slop
label: Westbound Records
personnel: Eddie Hazel, Garry Shider, Ron Bykowski – lead & rhythm guitar

tracks.t: You Can't Miss What You Can't Measure

about: Funkadelic's fifth studio album, released on Westbound Records in mid-1973.

title: Dread At The Control Dubwise
label: Dread At The Controls
about: A dub companion to Mikey Dread's 1979 set Dread at the Controls, named after the radio show that made the Jamaican broadcaster and producer famous. It presents stripped-down, effects-laden instrumental versions of his productions.

title: The Cars
label: Elektra
personnel: David Robinson – drums, percussion, Syndrums, backing vocals
Elliot Easton – lead guitar, backing vocals
Greg Hawkes – keyboards, percussion, saxophone, backing vocals

tracks.t: I'm In Touch With Your World

about: The self-titled first album by Boston band the Cars, put out by Elektra in June 1978.

title: American Dream
label: DFA
personnel: James Murphy – vocals, drums, bass, guitar, synthesizers, piano
Al Doyle – piano, synthesizers, guitar, vocals Nancy Whang, Tyler Pope Matt Thornley, Korey Richey
about: LCD Soundsystem's comeback studio album, issued by DFA and Columbia in September 2017 after the band reunited. Wikipedia counts it as the group's fifth studio release.

title: Skeleton Tree
label: Bad Seed Ltd.
personnel: Nick Cave – vocals, piano, Wurlitzer, synthesizer, vibraphone, backing vocals
Warren Ellis – synthesizer, loops, Wurlitzer, piano, baritone tenor guitar, violin, viola, drum treatments, drum loops, backing vocals
Jim Sclavunos – percussion, vibraphone, tubular bells, backing vocals
George Vjestica – acoustic guitar, backing vocals
about: The sixteenth studio album from Australian group Nick Cave and the Bad Seeds, released in September 2016 through the band's own Bad Seed Ltd. via Kobalt.

label: Warner Bros. Records
personnel: Prince – Lead vocals, backing vocals, electric guitar, bass guitar, keyboard, piano, synthesiser, drums, percussion
Dez Dickerson – vocals, electric guitar, backing vocals
Lisa Coleman, Jill Jones – backing vocals

tracks.t: Something In The Water (Does Not Compute)
All The Critics Love U In New York

about: Prince's fifth studio album and the first to credit his backing group the Revolution. He produced it himself, recording in Minnesota and Hollywood, and Warner Bros. issued it in October 1982.

title: Debut
label: One Little Indian
personnel: Björk – lead vocals, arranger, programmer, basslines, keyboards, brass
Garry Hughes, Marius de Vries, Martin Virgo, Paul Waller – keyboards

tracks.t: There's More To Life Than This (Recorded Live At The Milk Bar Toilets)

about: Björk's first international solo studio album, co-produced with Nellee Hooper and released in July 1993 on One Little Indian, with Elektra handling the US.

title: Lost In Translation (Music From The Motion Picture Soundtrack)
label: Emperor Norton

tracks.t: Brian Reitzell & Roger Joseph Manning-The Shibuya
Brian Reitzell & Roger Joseph Manning Jr.– On Subway
The Jesus And Mary Chain– Just Like Honey

about: Companion album to Sofia Coppola's 2003 film, overseen by Brian Reitzell and released on Emperor Norton. It leans on dream pop and shoegaze, featuring Kevin Shields, Air, Phoenix and the Jesus and Mary Chain, and was well received by critics.

title: Making Movies
label: Warner Bros. Records
about: Dire Straits' third studio album, the follow-up to Communiqué, released in October 1980 by Vertigo, with Warner Bros. distributing it in the US.

title: Commune
label: Rocket Recordings
about: The second studio album by Swedish experimental collective Goat, released in September 2014 via Rocket Recordings, with Sub Pop handling North America.

title: Confuse The Marketplace
label: DFA
about: A DFA Records EP pressed as a 12-inch that gathered, for North American buyers, B-sides from LCD Soundsystem's European Sound of Silver singles. It opens with the long track Freak Out/Starry Eyes.

title: Warpaint
label: Rough Trade
about: The self-titled second studio album by Los Angeles indie rock group Warpaint, co-produced by the band with Flood and released on Rough Trade in January 2014.

title: Slade Alive!
label: Polydor
personnel: Noddy Holder – lead vocals, rhythm guitar
Dave Hill – lead guitar, backing vocals

tracks.t: In Like A Shot From My Gun
Get Down And Get With It

about: Slade's first live record, cut over three nights in October 1971 at Command Studios in London with Chas Chandler producing. Polydor released it in 1972; it reached number two in Britain and topped the Australian chart.

title: Low
label: Parlophone
personnel: David Bowie – vocals, saxophones, guitar, bass, harmonica, keyboards

tracks.t: Always Crashing In The Same Car
A New Career In A New Town

about: The first entry in David Bowie's Berlin Trilogy, made with Brian Eno and producer Tony Visconti. Its first side holds short, fragmentary songs while the second consists mainly of ambient instrumentals, and its sound proved hugely influential on later post-punk and electronic music.

title: Fair Warning
label: Warner Bros. Records
personnel: Eddie Van Halen – guitar, synthesizers, backing vocals
Michael Anthony – bass guitar, backing vocals
about: The fourth Van Halen record, generally regarded as the band's darkest and heaviest album of the David Lee Roth era. It sold more slowly than its predecessors at first but eventually went double platinum and is admired for Eddie Van Halen's guitar work.

title: Capitol Cuts
label: ATO Records
about: A live set by Austin soul band Black Pumas recorded in Studio A at Capitol Studios in Los Angeles, captured direct to acetate without overdubs. Issued by ATO Records, it features eight performances including an extended version of Colors.

title: Just Another Way To Say I Love You
label: Warner Bros Records

tracks.t: Heavenly, That's What You Are To Me
I'll Do For You Anything You Want Me To
What Am I Gonna Do With You
Let Me Live My Life Lovin' You Babe

about: Barry White's fourth studio album, issued on 20th Century Records and produced by White himself. It continued his run of lush orchestral soul and included the hit What Am I Gonna Do with You.

title: Invisible Touch
label: Atlantic Records

tracks.t: Part One - In The Glow Of The Night

about: The thirteenth Genesis studio album and the best-selling record of their career. Featuring Phil Collins, Tony Banks and Mike Rutherford, it yielded five US top-five singles, among them the title song, which reached number one in America.

title: Blue 4 U
label: Astro Lizard Records
about: A nine-track release by His Eyes Have Fangs, a Los Angeles project involving skateboarder Tony Alva with Matthew and Rachel Anne Rainwater. Issued on Astro Lizard Records, it blends dream rock, surf and psychedelic textures and appeared on CD and limited white vinyl.

title: Hunky Dory
label: Parlophone
personnel: David Bowie – vocals, guitar, alto and tenor saxophone, piano
Mick Ronson – guitar, vocals, Mellotron, arrangements
about: David Bowie's fourth studio album, a piano-led set featuring Changes, Oh! You Pretty Things and Life on Mars?. It sold modestly on release but gained success after Ziggy Stardust and is now viewed as one of his finest works.

title: Waylon & Willie
label: RCA Victor

tracks.t: Mammas Don't Let Your Babies Grow Up To Be Cowboys
If You Can Touch Her At All
It's Not Supposed To Be That Way
I Can Get Off On You
The Wurlitzer Prize (I Don't Want To Get Over You)

about: The first collaborative studio album by country singers Waylon Jennings and Willie Nelson, released by RCA. It includes the hit Mammas Don't Let Your Babies Grow Up to Be Cowboys, which topped the country chart and won a Grammy.

title: Layla And Other Assorted Love Songs
label: RSO
personnel: Bobby Whitlock – vocals, keyboards; acoustic guitar

tracks.t: Nobody Knows You When You're Down And Out
Why Does Love Got To Be So Sad?
Have You Ever Loved A Woman

about: The sole studio record by Eric Clapton's band Derek and the Dominos, issued as a double LP and produced by Tom Dowd with the group. Duane Allman added lead and slide guitar to most tracks. Sales were weak at first, but it later went gold and entered the Grammy Hall of Fame.

title: Out Of The Blue
label: Jet Records
personnel: Jeff Lynne – vocals, guitars, Wurlitzer electric piano
Minimoog Bev Bevan – drums, Rototoms, cymbals, backing vocals
Richard Tandy – piano, Minimoog, clavinet, guitar
about: A double album written by Jeff Lynne in a few weeks at a Swiss chalet and then recorded in Munich. It climbed to number four in both Britain and America and stands as the most commercially successful studio release by Electric Light Orchestra.

title: Beggars Banquet
label: London Records
personnel: Brian Jones – guitar, harmonica, Mellotron, sitar, tambura, vocals
Bill Wyman – bass, vocals, shekere, maracas
Charlie Watts – drums, claves, tambourine, tabla, vocals
about: The first Rolling Stones LP produced by Jimmy Miller, it moved the band away from psychedelic pop toward blues and roots-based rock. Critics hailed it as a comeback, and it reached the top five in both the UK and the US.

title: Wild And Peaceful
label: De-Lite Records
personnel: Dennis "Dee Tee" Thomas – alto saxophone, flute, congas, vocals
Ronald Bell – tenor and soprano saxophones, vocals

tracks.t: This Is You, This Is Me
Life Is What You Make It

about: Self-produced by Kool & the Gang for De-Lite, this record became the group's commercial breakthrough and was certified gold. It yielded their first three top-ten singles, among them Jungle Boogie, and reached the top ten of the R&B album chart.
cdNote: CD listed in your My CDs playlist

title: Document
label: I.R.S. Records
personnel: Peter Buck – guitar, dulcimer on "King of
Birds" Mike Mills – bass guitar, keyboards, backing vocals

tracks.t: It's The End Of The World As We Know It (And I Feel Fine)

about: R.E.M.'s first collaboration with co-producer Scott Litt, released on I.R.S. Records. It became their first top-ten album in the US and their first platinum record, helped by the hit single The One I Love.

title: Illadelph Halflife (Clean LP)
label: DGC
personnel: The Grand Negaz, Questlove, Black Thought, Kelo, Q-Tip (The Ummah), Raphael Saadiq, Scratch, Chaos, L.A. Jay, Slimkid3, Scott Storch
about: Released on DGC/Geffen, the Roots' third album has a harder and wider-ranging sound than its predecessor and includes guest turns from artists such as D'Angelo and Cassandra Wilson. The Source later placed it among its 100 best rap albums.

title: Seventeen Seconds
label: Music On Vinyl
about: The Cure recorded and mixed this sparse record in about a week on a very small budget, with Mike Hedges and Robert Smith producing. It reached number 20 in the UK and is frequently cited as an early gothic rock landmark.

title: Achtung Baby
label: Island Records

tracks.t: Even Better Than The Real Thing
Until The End Of The World
Who's Gonna Ride Your Wild Horses
Tryin' To Throw Your Arms Around The World

about: Produced by Daniel Lanois and Brian Eno, this release saw U2 reinvent their sound with industrial, electronic and alternative influences. It debuted at the top of the Billboard 200, sold roughly 18 million copies and earned a Grammy.
vinylColor: Red Translucent, 180 Gram / Blue Translucent. 180 Gram

title: Physical Graffiti
label: Swan Song
personnel: Jimmy Page – electric, acoustic, lap steel and slide guitars, production
John Paul Jones – bass guitar, mandolin, acoustic guitar, keyboards
about: Led Zeppelin's first release on their Swan Song label, this double album combined new songs cut at Headley Grange in 1974 with unused earlier recordings. Its intricate die-cut sleeve delayed release, and it went on to top the UK chart and sell over eight million US copies.

title: Roosevelt
label: City Slang
about: The first full-length album by Roosevelt, the stage name of German producer and singer Marius Lauber. It presents his synth-pop and indie electronic style and was released in August 2016.

title: Cyrano (Original Motion Picture Soundtrack)
label: Decca
personnel: Peter Dinklage, Hayley Bennett, Beverly Rudd, Kelvin Harrison Jr. – vocals
about: Music for Joe Wright's 2021 film Cyrano starring Peter Dinklage, composed and produced by Aaron and Bryce Dessner, with song lyrics by Matt Berninger and Carin Besser. The cast sings the songs, and the London Contemporary Orchestra plays the score. Decca issued it.

title: In Outer Space
label: Atlantic Records

tracks.t: All You Ever Think About Is Sex
I Wish I Looked A Little Better
A Fun Bunch Of Guys From Outer Space

about: Self-produced by Ron and Russell Mael for Atlantic, this Sparks record reached number 88 in the US. It includes Cool Places, a duet with Jane Wiedlin that became the duo's biggest American hit, though reviews were mixed.

title: What Went Down
label: Transgressive Records
personnel: Yannis Philippakis – vocals, guitar, art direction
about: Produced by James Ford, the fourth Foals album entered the UK chart at number three and gave the band their best US placing at the time. Critics received it favourably.

title: Propaganda
label: Island Records

tracks.t: At Home, At Work, At Play
Don't Leave Me Alone With Her
Never Turn Your Back On Mother Earth
Something For The Girl With Everything

about: Sparks followed their breakthrough Kimono My House with this Island release produced by Muff Winwood. It made the UK top ten, and its cover pictures the Mael brothers tied up and gagged.

title: Red (Taylor's Version)
label: Republic Records
personnel: Mike Meadows – guitar, synthesizer, vocals, mandolin, piano

tracks.t: I Knew You Were Trouble (Taylor's Version)
We Are Never Ever Getting Back Together (Taylor's Version)
Message In A Bottle (Taylor's Version) (From The Vault)
I Bet You Think About Me (Taylor's Version) (From The Vault)
The Very First Night (Taylor's Version) (From The Vault)
All Too Well (10 Minute Version) (Taylor's Version) (From The Vault)

about: Taylor Swift's re-recording of her 2012 album Red, made after the dispute over ownership of her original masters. It adds previously unreleased songs from the vault, including a ten-minute version of All Too Well, and debuted at number one in the US.

title: Pop
label: Island Records
personnel: The Edge – guitar, keyboards, backing vocals

tracks.t: If God Will Send His Angels
If You Wear That Velvet Dress

about: U2 mixed alternative rock with techno and electronic dance styles on this record produced by Flood, Howie B and Steve Osborne. It topped charts in many countries, yet its overall sales were low for the band, who later voiced regret about the finished product.

title: Introspective
label: EMI-Manhattan Records

tracks.t: Always On My Mind / In My House

about: Pet Shop Boys built this album from extended tracks of six minutes or more, inverting the usual pattern of releasing singles first and remixes later. Several producers including Trevor Horn contributed, and it peaked at number two in the UK.

title: Pink Flag
label: Pinkflag
personnel: Graham Lewis – bass guitar, backing vocals, sleeve concept
Colin Newman – vocals, guitar, backing vocals
about: Wire's first album, produced by Mike Thorne and recorded at Advision Studios in London for Harvest. Well received at the time, it is now considered a key post-punk record and influenced later American hardcore punk.

title: Dire Straits
label: Vertigo
personnel: Mark Knopfler – vocals, lead and rhythm guitars
David Knopfler – rhythm guitar, backing vocals
John Illsley – bass guitar, backing vocals
about: The first album by Dire Straits, produced by Muff Winwood and cut at Basing Street Studios in London. Driven by the hit Sultans of Swing, it peaked at number two in the US and number five in the UK, later going double platinum in both.

title: Mixed Up
label: Rhino Records
personnel: Robert Smith – vocals, guitar, six-string bass, keyboards

tracks.t: Why Can't I Be You? (Extended Mix-Remastered 2018)

about: A Fiction Records collection of reworked versions of earlier Cure hits, reflecting the dance and remix culture of the period. It also contained the new single Never Enough and was followed decades later by a second remix set, Torn Down.

title: October
label: Island Records
personnel: The Edge – guitar, piano, backing vocals

tracks.t: I Threw A Brick Through A Window

about: U2's follow-up to Boy, produced by Steve Lillywhite, reflects members' involvement with a Christian fellowship. Recording was rushed after Bono lost a case of draft lyrics on tour, and reviews on release were mixed.

title: The Empire Strikes Back (Original Soundtrack)
label: RSO
personnel: John Williams – Conductor London Symphony Orchestra

tracks.t: The Training Of A Jedi Knight
The Heroics Of Luke And Han

about: John Williams's score for the second Star Wars film, first issued by RSO in the US as a double LP shortly before the movie opened. Later editions included an abridged early CD and a 2018 remaster from Walt Disney Records.

title: Roxy - Tonight's The Night Live
label: Reprise Records
personnel: Neil Young – vocals, guitar, piano, harmonica
Ben Keith – pedal steel guitar, slide guitar, vocals
about: Recorded over three nights in September 1973 when the Roxy in Los Angeles reopened, with Neil Young backed by the Santa Monica Flyers. Because the shows came soon after the Tonight's the Night sessions, the set is made up almost entirely of songs from that record.

title: Almost Famous (Music From The Motion Picture)
label: Geffen Records

tracks.t: Todd Rundgren– It Wouldn't Have Made Any Difference
Yes– I've Seen All Good People : Your Move
Rod Stewart– Every Picture Tells A Story
The Allman Brothers Band– One Way Out
David Bowie– I'm Waiting For The Man
Thunderclap Newman– Something In The Air

about: The companion album to Cameron Crowe's film about a teenage rock journalist in the early 1970s. It gathers classic rock tracks by acts such as Led Zeppelin, Simon & Garfunkel, the Who and Elton John, plus a song by the film's fictional band Stillwater.

title: A Legendary Performer - Volume 3
label: RCA

tracks.t: Excerpts From Interview With Elvis And The Colonel

about: The third volume in RCA's Legendary Performer series of Elvis Presley compilations, released the year after his death. It mixes familiar recordings with material that had not previously appeared on an official RCA album.
vinylColor: Blue Border, Non-Embossed Jacket / Picture Disc

title: Station To Station
label: Parlophone
personnel: David Bowie – vocals, guitar, saxophone, Minimoog, Mellotron
about: David Bowie's tenth studio album, recorded in Los Angeles and introducing his Thin White Duke persona. Its six long songs blend funk and soul with krautrock influences, bridging Young Americans and the Berlin period, and include Golden Years.

title: Rust Never Sleeps
label: Reprise Records
personnel: Neil Young – vocals, guitars, harmonica, organ, percussion
Frank "Poncho" Sampedro – electric guitar, backing vocals

tracks.t: My My, Hey Hey (Out Of The Blue)
Hey Hey, My My (Into The Black)

about: Neil Young's album with Crazy Horse, built mainly from live recordings with overdubs. An acoustic first side contrasts with a loud electric second, and it is bookended by two versions of the song My My, Hey Hey.

title: The Mail Must Go Through
label: Mad About Records
about: A scarce West Coast funk LP by a group called The Cult, issued on Starburst Records, a label apparently based in Las Vegas, and recorded in Hollywood studios. Mostly raw funk with a few ballads, it became a collector's item and was reissued by Mad About Records in 2021.

title: Nine
label: Forever Living Originals
about: The fifth studio album by the anonymous British collective Sault, led by producer Inflo and singer Cleo Sol. It was offered only as a download and on streaming services and was deliberately withdrawn after 99 days.

title: Newport 1958
label: Columbia

tracks.t: My God Is Real (Yes, God Is Real)
He's Got The Whole World In His Hands
I'm Going To Live The Life I Sing About In My Song
Joshua Fit The Battle Of Jericho
His Eye Is On The Sparrow

about: A Columbia LP capturing the gospel singer's set at the 1958 Newport Jazz Festival in Rhode Island. It documents Jackson performing spirituals and hymns before a jazz festival crowd, the same event at which she also appeared with Duke Ellington's orchestra.

title: No. 1 In Heaven
label: Elektra
personnel: Chris Bennett, Dennis Young, Jack Moran – backing vocals
about: The eighth studio record by the Mael brothers' duo, made in Munich with producer Giorgio Moroder. It swapped their guitar-band approach for sequencers and synthesizers, and its single The Number One Song in Heaven gave them their first UK hit in years. Initially poorly reviewed, it is now seen as an influential synth-pop record.

title: Live In Montreux 1980
label: Ear Music Classics

tracks.t: If This World Was Mine / Ain't Nothing Like The Real Thing / Ain't No Mountain High Enough
How Sweet It Is (To Be Loved By You)
I Heard It Through The Grapevine
Inner City Blues (Make Me Wanna Holler)
If This World Was Mine / Ain't Nothing Like The Real Thing / Ain't No Mountain High Enough
How Sweet It Is (To Be Loved By You)
I Heard It Through The Grapevine
Inner City Blues (Make Me Wanna Holler)

about: A two-disc concert recording of Marvin Gaye performing at the Montreux Jazz Festival in Switzerland in 1980, issued in 2003. The set runs from his late-1970s funk material through a Tammi Terrell tribute medley and songs from What's Going On.

title: Risqué
label: Atlantic Records
personnel: Alfa Anderson, Luci Martin – lead vocals
Michelle Cobbs, Ullanda McCullough – backing vocals
Robert Sabino, Andy Schwartz, Raymond Jones – keyboards

tracks.t: Will You Cry (When You Hear This Song)

about: Chic's third studio album, produced by Nile Rodgers and Bernard Edwards for Atlantic. It contains Good Times, later heavily sampled in early hip hop, and reached the US top five while earning platinum certification. It is widely regarded as one of the strongest records of the disco era.

title: This Is Happening
label: DFA
personnel: James Murphy – vocals, guitar, drums, bass, piano, EMS VCS3 Putney, Korg Poly Ensemble, EMS PolySynthi, EMS Synthi A, Yamaha CS-60, Casio MT-68, percussion, Simmons, cowbell, Roland System 100, Synare, Wurlitzer electric piano, tambourine
Roland TR-606 Pat Mahoney – vocals, drums
about: The third LCD Soundsystem album, which James Murphy presented at the time as the group's farewell. Recorded in Los Angeles, it includes Drunk Girls and Dance Yrself Clean and became the band's highest-charting release up to then.

title: 24 Karat Hits!
label: Analogue Productions

tracks.t: Wear My Ring Around Your Neck

about: A greatest-hits collection issued by the audiophile label DCC Compact Classics as a gold-disc CD. It gathers 24 well-known Elvis Presley recordings such as Heartbreak Hotel, Hound Dog, Jailhouse Rock and Suspicious Minds.

title: A Rush Of Blood To The Head
label: Parlophone
personnel: Chris Martin – lead vocals, piano, acoustic guitar, rhythm guitar
Jonny Buckland – guitar, backing vocals, twelve-string slide guitar
Will Champion – drums, percussion, backing vocals

tracks.t: God Put A Smile Upon Your Face
A Rush Of Blood To The Head

about: Coldplay's second studio album, co-produced by the band and Ken Nelson, leaning more on piano and electric guitar than their debut. It topped charts in many countries, sold in the tens of millions, and won Grammy awards, with singles including In My Place, The Scientist and Clocks.

title: New York
label: Sire Records
personnel: Lou Reed – lead and background vocals, guitar
Dion DiMucci, Jeffrey Lesser – backing vocals
about: Lou Reed's fifteenth solo studio album, released on Sire. Built on plain guitar-based rock, it carries pointed lyrics about social and political life in late-1980s New York, and Reed intended it to be heard straight through. It was a critical success, and Dirty Blvd. led the US modern rock chart.

title: Moanin'
label: Blue Note
about: A Blue Note hard bop album by Art Blakey and the Jazz Messengers, recorded in October 1958 with Lee Morgan, Benny Golson, Bobby Timmons and Jymie Merritt. Its title track by Timmons became a jazz standard, and the record is among Blakey's best known.

title: Here
label: RCA
personnel: Alicia Keys – drum programming, Fender Rhodes, keyboards, Moog bass, piano, vocals, background vocals

tracks.t: Blended Family (What You Do For Love)

about: Alicia Keys' sixth studio album, released by RCA and recorded largely in New York. It drew generally favorable reviews, debuted at number two on the Billboard 200, and topped the R&B/hip-hop albums chart. Its singles were In Common and Blended Family (What You Do for Love).

title: Master Of Puppets
label: Blackened

tracks.t: The Thing That Should Not Be

about: Metallica's third studio album, recorded in Copenhagen with producer Flemming Rasmussen and released by Elektra. It was the final album with bassist Cliff Burton, who died later in 1986. Widely ranked among the greatest metal records, it was added to the US National Recording Registry in 2015.

title: Harvest
label: Reprise Records
personnel: Neil Young – vocals, guitar, piano, harmonica
David Crosby, Stephen Stills, Graham Nash – backing vocals

tracks.t: Are You Ready For The Country?
The Needle And The Damage Done

about: Neil Young's fourth studio album, issued by Reprise with guest singers including Crosby, Stills, Nash, Linda Ronstadt and James Taylor. It became the top-selling US album of 1972 and yielded the number-one single Heart of Gold. It remains his best-selling record.

title: Everybody Else Is Doing It, So Why Can't We?
label: Island Records
personnel: Dolores O'Riordan – lead vocals, acoustic guitar
Noel Hogan – lead guitar, backing vocals
about: The Cranberries' first full-length album, released by Island and produced by Stephen Street, with songs by Dolores O'Riordan and Noel Hogan. It reached number one in the UK and Ireland and includes Linger and Dreams, selling millions of copies worldwide.

title: So Far… The Best Of Sinéad O'Connor
label: Chrysalis

tracks.t: The Last Day Of Our Acquaintance
I Am Stretched On Your Grave
Success Has Made A Failure Of Our Home
You Made Me The Thief Of Your Heart
Just Like U Said It Would B

about: A greatest-hits set drawing on Sinead O'Connor's first four studio albums plus several collaborations. Released on Chrysalis, it was her last album for that label, and it charted in the top three in Ireland and inside the UK top 30.

title: Sound And Color
label: ATO Records
personnel: Brittany Howard – vocals, guitar, vibraphone, percussion, keyboards

tracks.t: Don't Wanna Fight No More (Live from Capitol Studio A)
Future People (Live from Capitol Studio A)
Over My Head (Live from Capitol Studio A)

about: Alabama Shakes' second studio album, released by ATO Records. Rooted in soul and Southern rock but more experimental than their debut, it entered the Billboard 200 at number one and collected several Grammy awards, with Don't Wanna Fight as its leading single.

title: Surfer Rosa
label: 4AD
personnel: Black Francis – vocals, rhythm guitar, acoustic guitar
about: The Pixies' first full-length studio album, issued by 4AD and recorded in Boston with Steve Albini engineering. Its raw, loud production and songs such as Gigantic and Where Is My Mind? earned acclaim, and it later went gold in the US and influenced many alternative rock acts.

title: Route 666
label: Not On Label
personnel: Roy "Wild Man" Edroso – Guitar, Vocals, Bass
about: The first album by the New York noise-punk group, released on Race Age Records. Trouser Press singled out its silkscreened sleeve as one of the best covers of the decade while describing the music as chaotic, humorous guitar noise.

title: Low In High School
label: Étienne

tracks.t: My Love, I'd Do Anything For You
Jacky's Only Happy When She's Up On The Stage
The Girl From Tel-Aviv Who Wouldn't Kneel
All The Young People Must Fall In Love
Who Will Protect Us From The Police?

about: Morrissey's eleventh solo studio album, produced by Joe Chiccarelli and released through BMG after sessions in France and Italy. It entered the UK chart at number five but received mixed reviews, and its cover image prompted reports about retailers refusing to stock it.

title: Rocket To Russia
label: Sire
personnel: Dee Dee Ramone – bass guitar, backing vocals

tracks.t: Why Is It Always This Way

about: The Ramones' third studio album on Sire, the last to feature founding drummer Tommy Ramone. With a bigger budget, it leaned toward surf and bubblegum pop and included covers of Do You Wanna Dance? and Surfin' Bird. It reached number 49 in the US.

title: Two Quid Deal?
label: Stax Records
personnel: Thomas Crimble – bass, vocals, keyboards, harmonica
Robert 'Bob' James – saxophone, flute, guitar, vocals
Krzysztof Henryk Juszkiewicz – organ, piano, accordion, harpsichord, mellotron, vocals, trumpet
Nick Graham – vocals, keyboards, bass, flute
about: The third LP by the London progressive rock band and their first for Transatlantic Records, released on its Big T imprint. It mixes progressive rock with jazz-rock touches.

title: Smell The Remains
label: Dom DOM
personnel: Amazon Bambi, Baby J., Cheez-it-Ritz, D.K., Dr. Id, Ju Suk Reet Meet, White Mohamed – drums, voice, effects, organ, bass, guitar, saxophone, tape

tracks.t: Forest Fire In Your Left Elbow

about: A release by Smegma, the experimental noise and free improvisation group formed in Pasadena, California, in 1973. It appears in the band's discography as a 1988 title, though further details about it could not be confirmed.

title: International Hotel Las Vegas, Nevada August 26, 1969
label: RCA Records

tracks.t: Baby What You Want Me To Do

about: A double LP from RCA/Legacy presenting Elvis Presley's complete midnight show of August 26, 1969, at the International Hotel in Las Vegas. It was released alongside the Live 1969 box set marking the 50th anniversary of his return to live performance.

title: Some Nights
label: Fueled By Ramen
personnel: Jack Antonoff – guitars, vocals, bass , drums, percussion
Andrew Dost – keyboards, piano, celeste, synthesizer, glockenspiel, guitar, bass, accordion, drums, percussion, trumpet, flugelhorn, vocals
Nate Ruess – lead vocals, background vocals
about: The second and last studio album by fun., released on Fueled by Ramen and largely produced by Jeff Bhasker. Mixing indie pop, theatrical rock and hip-hop production, it contained the chart-topping single We Are Young and was certified triple platinum in the US.

title: Discovery
label: ADA
personnel: Thomas Bangalter, Guy-Manuel de Homem-Christo – vocals, vocoders, sequencers, sampling, synthesizers, Wurlitzer electric piano, guitars, bass, talkbox, drum machines
about: Daft Punk's second studio album, recorded in their Paris home studio and drawing on disco, garage house and R&B with heavy sampling. Paired with the anime film Interstella 5555, it produced One More Time and other singles, and its reputation rose greatly over time.

title: Living In The USA
label: Asylum Records
personnel: Peter Asher – vocals, cowbell, tambourine, shaker, sleigh bells

tracks.t: When I Grow Too OId To Dream

about: Linda Ronstadt's ninth studio album, produced by Peter Asher. It went to number one in the US and includes covers such as Chuck Berry's Back in the U.S.A. and Smokey Robinson's Ooo Baby Baby.

title: Uh Oh ... No Brakes!
label: Twin/Tone Records
personnel: Kim Kane – Rhythm guitar, backing vocals
Marshall Keith – Lead guitar, keyboards, backing vocals
Dan Palenski – drums, percussion, backing vocals
John Chumbris – Bass guitar, keyboards, backing vocals, guitar

tracks.t: The Brain That Refused To Die

about: A 1985 album by Washington, D.C. garage and punk band the Slickee Boys, released by Twin/Tone and produced by the group. Almost half of it consists of new versions of older songs, alongside covers of the Dogs, the Squires and Perry Como.

title: Never Say Never
label: 415 Records
about: A four-song EP by San Francisco new wave band Romeo Void, issued by 415 Records. Its title track became a dance chart hit in 1982 and is the group's signature song; the other songs are In the Dark, Present Tense and Not Safe.

title: Screen Violence
label: EMI
personnel: Martin Doherty – keyboards, guitar, bass, vocals
about: The fourth album by Scottish synth-pop trio Chvrches, made partly remotely during the pandemic and steeped in horror film imagery. It features a guest vocal from Robert Smith of the Cure on How Not to Drown.

title: American Beauty
label: Warner Bros. Records
personnel: Jerry Garcia – guitar, pedal steel, piano, vocals
Phil Lesh – bass, guitar, piano, vocals
about: The Grateful Dead's fifth studio album, released months after Workingman's Dead and sharing its acoustic, harmony-driven Americana sound. It includes Truckin', Ripple, Box of Rain and Sugar Magnolia.

title: Highway 61 Revisited
label: Columbia
personnel: Bob Dylan – vocals, guitar, harmonica, piano, siren whistle

tracks.t: It Takes A Lot To Laugh, It Takes A Train To Cry

about: Bob Dylan's sixth studio album, produced by Bob Johnston and Tom Wilson, extended the electric rock approach of his previous record, with only the long closer Desolation Row played acoustically. Named after the highway linking his Minnesota birthplace to the musical South, it reached the top five in the US and UK.
cdNote: CD listed in your My CDs playlist

title: Give 'Em Enough Rope
label: Epic
personnel: Joe Strummer – lead and backing vocals, rhythm guitar
Mick Jones – lead guitar, backing vocals, lead vocals on
"Stay Free" Paul Simonon – bass guitar, backing vocals

tracks.t: All The Young Punks (New Boots And Contracts)

about: The Clash's second studio album was produced by Sandy Pearlman and issued by CBS Records. It climbed to number two in the UK and became the first Clash album released in the United States, arriving there ahead of the American edition of their debut.

title: Strange Days
label: Elektra Records

tracks.t: I Can't See Your Face In My Mind

about: Released by Elektra just eight months after their debut, the Doors' second studio album was produced by Paul A. Rothchild. It reached number three in the US, went platinum and yielded the singles People Are Strange and Love Me Two Times.
cdNote: CD listed in your My CDs playlist

title: Zaba
label: Harvest Records
about: The debut studio album by English band Glass Animals was produced by singer Dave Bayley with Paul Epworth as executive producer. Its psychedelic indie pop draws on tropical percussion and a children's book about a jungle, and it did especially well in Australia.

title: Power, Corruption & Lies
label: London Records
personnel: Bernard Sumner – vocals, guitars, melodica, synthesizers and programming
Peter Hook – 4- and 6-stringed bass and electronic percussion
Stephen Morris – drums, synthesizers and programming
Gillian Gilbert – synthesizers, guitars and programming
about: New Order's self-produced second studio album, issued by Factory Records, leaned further into synthesisers and electronic rhythms than their debut Movement. Peter Saville's sleeve later appeared on a Royal Mail stamp, and the record is widely ranked among the best albums of the 1980s.

title: Black Holes And Revelations
label: Warner Bros. Records
personnel: Matthew Bellamy – vocals, lead and rhythm guitars, piano, synthesizers
about: Muse's fourth studio album, co-produced with Rich Costey, entered the charts at number one in the UK and several other countries and made the US top ten. It was shortlisted for the Mercury Prize and has sold several million copies worldwide.

title: Crash
label: Asylum Records
about: Charli XCX's fifth studio album, released through Asylum and Atlantic, closed out her deal with Asylum. Trading her experimental hyperpop leanings for polished dance-pop, it topped the charts in the UK, Ireland and Australia.

title: Topical Dancer
label: Deewee
about: The first full-length album by Belgian duo Charlotte Adigéry and Bolis Pupul came out on the Deewee label and was co-written and co-produced with Soulwax. Sung in several languages, its songs tackle racism, identity and abuse over playful electronic grooves.

title: Fear Of Music
label: Warner Bros Records
personnel: Jerry Harrison – guitar, backing vocals, keyboards
Tina Weymouth – bass guitar, backing vocals
about: Talking Heads' third studio album was co-produced with Brian Eno and recorded in New York in spring 1979. Issued by Sire, it featured the singles Life During Wartime, I Zimbra and Cities and is often counted among the band's strongest work.

title: Marquee Moon
label: Elektra
personnel: Tom Verlaine – guitar, keyboards, lead vocals
about: Television's debut studio album, released by Elektra, captured the New York band's interlocking twin-guitar style developed at CBGB. Though modest commercially in the US, it became one of the most admired records of the punk and new wave era.

title: Unknown Pleasures
label: Factory
about: Joy Division's debut studio album was issued by Factory Records and produced by Martin Hannett, who recorded it over a few weekends at Strawberry Studios in Stockport. Its famous Peter Saville cover reproduces a plot of radio pulsar signals.

title: Unlimited Love
label: Warner Records
personnel: John Frusciante – electric guitar, vocals, synthesizer, acoustic guitar
Chad Smith – drums, percussion, tambourine, bass, shaker
about: The Red Hot Chili Peppers' twelfth studio album marked the return of guitarist John Frusciante and producer Rick Rubin. Arriving six years after The Getaway, it topped the charts in many countries, including the United States.

title: Fugazi (7 Songs)
label: Dischord Records
about: Fugazi's debut release, often called 7 Songs, is an EP issued on vinyl by Dischord and produced by Ted Niceley with the band. Ian MacKaye handled all guitar parts, and the record includes Waiting Room, frequently cited as the group's best-known song.

title: A Moon Shaped Pool
label: XL Recordings

tracks.t: Tinker Tailor Soldier Sailor Rich Man Poor Man Beggar Man Thief

about: Radiohead's ninth studio album, produced by Nigel Godrich, appeared digitally in May 2016 and in shops that June via XL Recordings. It features string and choir arrangements by Jonny Greenwood and includes long-gestating songs such as True Love Waits and Burn the Witch.

title: Horses
label: Legacy
about: Patti Smith's debut studio album was produced by John Cale and recorded at Electric Lady Studios for Arista. It reached the Billboard top 50, drew wide critical praise, and was later added to the Library of Congress National Recording Registry.

title: Disintegration
label: Fiction Records

tracks.t: The Same Deep Water As You

about: The Cure's eighth studio album, recorded with co-producer David M. Allen at Hookend studios in Oxfordshire and released by Fiction, brought the band back to the brooding gothic rock of their early 1980s records.

title: Folklore
label: Republic Records
personnel: Aaron Dessner – piano, guitar, Mellotron, OP-1, synth bass, percussion, bass, synthesizer, keyboards
Evan Smith – saxophone, keyboards, flute, guitar
Jack Antonoff – drums, percussion, guitar, keyboards, piano, bass, vocals
about: Taylor Swift's eighth studio album was surprise-released through Republic Records after being made during pandemic lockdown, largely with Aaron Dessner and Jack Antonoff. It was the top-selling US album of 2020 and won the Grammy for Album of the Year.

title: Cut
label: Island Records

tracks.t: I Heard It Through The Grapevine

about: The Slits' debut album was produced by Dennis Bovell and recorded at Ridge Farm Studios in Sussex. It merges punk energy with reggae and dub rhythms and touches of art pop.

title: In Utero (2013 Mix)
label: UMe
personnel: Kurt Cobain – guitar, vocals, art direction, design, photography
Dave Grohl – drums, percussion, backing vocals

tracks.t: Frances Farmer Will Have Her Revenge On Seattle

about: Nirvana's third and last studio album was recorded with Steve Albini for a rawer sound than Nevermind and topped the US and UK charts. The 2013 Mix refers to a fresh mix made for the album's 20th anniversary reissue that September.

title: Dry
label: Too Pure
about: PJ Harvey's debut studio album was released by Too Pure and recorded by her trio at a small studio in Yeovil. Early copies came with a bonus set of demo versions, and the album was later issued in the US by Indigo.

title: Uh Huh Her
label: Island Records
personnel: PJ Harvey – vocals, guitars, bass, piano, melodica, accordion, autoharp
Rob Ellis – drums, percussion, backing vocals

tracks.t: The Life And Death Of Mr. Badmouth
The Darker Days Of Me And Him

about: PJ Harvey's sixth studio album, released by Island, was written, played and produced almost entirely by Harvey herself over two years, with Rob Ellis adding final drums. It became her best-charting album in the United States.

title: Black Celebration
label: Reprise Records
about: Depeche Mode's fifth studio album, released by Mute and recorded in London and West Berlin, was produced with Daniel Miller and Gareth Jones. Critics often treat it as the opening of the band's celebrated late-1980s run.

title: Death Of A Bachelor
label: Fueled By Ramen
personnel: Brendon Urie – vocals, guitar, bass, keyboards, drums, background vocals

tracks.t: Don't Threaten Me With A Good Time
The Good, The Bad And The Dirty

about: Panic! at the Disco's fifth studio album was effectively a Brendon Urie solo project and the first without drummer Spencer Smith. It gave the band its first US number-one album and received a Grammy nomination for Best Rock Album.

title: Pressure Drop - The Golden Tracks
label: Purple Pyramid
about: A compilation of recordings by the Jamaican group Toots and the Maytals, taking its name from their song Pressure Drop. AllMusic lists a January 2011 release lasting roughly an hour; it was later reissued on coloured vinyl by Cleopatra Records.

title: Boys & Girls
label: ATO Records
personnel: Brittany Howard – lead vocals, guitar, piano, percussion
Heath Fogg – guitar, backing vocals, percussion
Zac Cockrell – bass, backing vocals, guitar
Steve Johnson – drums, backing vocals, percussion
about: Alabama Shakes' debut studio album, released by ATO Records and co-produced with Andrija Tokic, reached the top ten in the US and number three in the UK. A tenth anniversary edition added a live KCRW session.

title: Entertainment!
label: Matador
about: Gang of Four's debut album, issued by EMI and in North America by Warner Bros., blends punk with funk and dub. Its politically charged lyrics and artwork helped make it a landmark of post-punk.

title: Plans
label: Music On Vinyl

tracks.t: Different Names For The Same Thing
I Will Follow You Into The Dark
Your Heart Is An Empty Room

about: Death Cab for Cutie's fifth studio album and first for major label Atlantic was produced by guitarist Chris Walla. It reached the US top five, earned a Grammy nomination, and included I Will Follow You into the Dark.

title: Wrecker
label: Estrus Records
about: The second full-length record by Bellingham garage rockers Mono Men, released on Estrus. Recorded at Egg Studios with engineer Conrad Uno, it explores a darker, minor-key take on garage rock.

title: Trompe Le Monde
label: 4AD

tracks.t: Bird Dream Of The Olympus Mons

about: The fourth Pixies studio album, produced by Gil Norton and recorded in Burbank, Paris and London. It was the band's last record before their split two years later and the final one with bassist Kim Deal, reaching number 7 in the UK.

title: Pixies (EP)
label: Vinyl Lovers
about: An EP collecting the remaining tracks from the 1987 Purple Tape demo session that Gary Smith recorded at Fort Apache Studios in Boston. Songs from the same session had earlier formed Come On Pilgrim; this set was issued by SpinART in the US and Cooking Vinyl in the UK.

title: (GI)
label: Rhino Records
personnel: Lorna Doom – bass guitar, backing vocals
about: The sole studio album by Los Angeles punk band the Germs, issued on Slash Records with Joan Jett as producer. The title abbreviates Germs Incognito, a name used to get gigs, and the record is widely regarded as one of the earliest full-length hardcore punk albums.

title: Everything Not Saved Will Be Lost: Part 2
label: Warner Records
about: Foals' sixth studio album and the second half of a two-part project begun earlier in 2019. Co-produced by the band and Brett Shaw, it gave Foals their first number one on the UK Albums Chart and was keyboardist Edwin Congreave's final album with them.

title: Wet Leg
label: Domino
about: The self-titled first album by Isle of Wight band Wet Leg, released by Domino and mainly produced by Dan Carey. It topped the UK and Australian charts, was shortlisted for the Mercury Prize, and won the Grammy for Best Alternative Music Album.

title: Wish You Were Here
label: Pink Floyd Records
personnel: David Gilmour – vocals, guitars, EMS Synthi AKS, bass, harmonica
Roger Waters – vocals, bass, EMS VCS 3, guitar, harmonica
Nick Mason – drums, percussion, timpani, cymbals
Richard Wright – Hammond organ, ARP String Ensemble, Minimoog, Steinway piano, EMS VCS 3, Hohner Clavinet D6, Wurlitzer EP-200 electric piano, Rhodes piano, harmonica, backing vocals
about: Pink Floyd's ninth studio album, recorded at EMI Studios in London as the follow-up to The Dark Side of the Moon. Its centrepiece, Shine On You Crazy Diamond, honours founding member Syd Barrett, and the record reached number one in both Britain and the United States.

title: Ahora Me Da Pena
label: World Circuit
about: A limited 12-inch vinyl release by Buena Vista Social Club, issued by World Circuit/BMG as a Record Store Day 2022 exclusive. It centres on the song Ahora Me Da Pena, a recording connected to the ensemble's 1990s Havana sessions.

title: Pornography
label: Elektra
personnel: Robert Smith – vocals, guitar, keyboards, cello
about: The Cure's fourth studio album, recorded at RAK Studios in London with co-producer Phil Thornalley. Initially poorly received by critics, it reached number 8 in the UK and has since come to be regarded as a landmark of gothic rock.

title: Oh, No! It's Devo
label: Warner Records
personnel: Mark Mothersbaugh – lead and background vocals, keyboards
Gerald Casale – lead and background vocals, bass guitar, keyboards
Bob Casale – guitar, keyboards, backing vocals
about: Devo's fifth studio album, produced by Roy Thomas Baker for Warner Bros. It leans more heavily on programmed synthesizers and drum machines than its predecessor, and includes the singles Peek-a-Boo! and That's Good.

title: Acoustics
label: Blackheart Records

tracks.t: You Don’t Know What You’ve Got
I Hate Myself For Loving You

about: A limited black vinyl LP issued for Record Store Day 2022 through Blackheart Records and Sony. It contains eight acoustic renditions of Joan Jett and Blackhearts songs, two of them recorded live in Los Angeles, including a cover of the Replacements' Androgynous.

title: Complete Captured Live
label: Parlophone
about: An expanded edition of Peter Tosh's concert recording Captured Live, documenting his performance at the Greek Theatre in Los Angeles. The set runs about an hour and a half and presents the reggae singer's full show rather than the shorter original selection.

title: Unsuitable For Airplay - The Lost KFAI Concert
label: Rhino Records

tracks.t: All Day And All Of The Night

about: An archival live recording by the Replacements of a concert originally broadcast on the Minneapolis community radio station KFAI. Rhino issued it as a Record Store Day 2022 double vinyl release, and it reached number 16 on the US vinyl albums chart.

title: Come Away With Me
label: Blue Note
personnel: Norah Jones – vocals, piano, Wurlitzer electric piano
Jesse Harris, Adam Levy, Kevin Breit, Adam Rogers, Tony Scherr – guitar

tracks.t: I've Got To See You Again

about: Norah Jones's first album, released on Blue Note Records. A slow-building success, it eventually topped the US chart, sold more than 27 million copies worldwide and won several Grammys in 2003, including Album of the Year.

title: Funky Kingston
label: Warner Bros Records

tracks.t: Love Is Gonna Let Me Down

about: The 1975 US edition of Funky Kingston, assembled by Island from earlier Maytals material, kept only three songs from the 1973 Jamaican album and added tracks from In the Dark plus Pressure Drop. This version became a celebrated reggae introduction for American listeners.

title: Bustin' + Dronin'
label: Parlophone

tracks.t: Death Of A Party (Well Blurred Remix)
On Your Own (Crouch End Broadway Mix)
Death Of A Party (Billy Whiskers Mix)

about: A double album first issued in Japan, pairing remixes of songs from Blur's self-titled album by artists such as Thurston Moore, William Orbit and Moby with a live session recorded for John Peel. It later appeared in limited quantities in the UK and US.

title: Roaring Lion
label: Pressure Sounds

tracks.t: Truths And Rights Jah Lion & The Upsetters
Upsetters Shuffle (Dub Plate Mix) The Upsetters
Roaring Lion Jah Lion & The Upsetters
Pride Augustus Pablo And The Upsetters
Generation From Creation Jah Lion & The Upsetters
Beat Down Comrade Man (Dub Plate) Junior Byles & The Upsetters
Natural Mystic (Original Upsetter Dub Plate Mix) Bob & The Upsetters The Upsetters

about: A Pressure Sounds compilation of sixteen mid-1970s Black Ark productions by Lee Perry and the Upsetters. Much of it comes from a single master tape, alongside dub plates and alternate mixes, and many tracks had not been released before.
vinylColor: Green And Black Silk Screen Sleeve

title: The King Of Ska
label: Burning Sounds
about: A vinyl collection of Desmond Dekker recordings gathering some of his best-known ska and reggae songs, including Israelites and 007 (Shanty Town).

title: Natty Rebel
label: Virgin
about: An album by Jamaican deejay U-Roy, one of a series of records he made with producer Tony Robinson in the mid-1970s. It was issued internationally by Virgin, whose Front Line imprint also released it in other markets.

title: Live From Coachella 2004
label: Demon Records
personnel: Black Francis – vocals, rhythm guitar, acoustic guitar
David Lovering – drums, percussion, backing vocals
Joey Santiago – lead guitar, backing vocals
about: A recording of the Pixies' 2004 Coachella main-stage performance during their reunion tour, issued as a limited double vinyl for Record Store Day 2022. The roughly twenty-song set marked the first vinyl release of this material.

title: Mahal
label: Dead Oceans
personnel: Chaz Bundick – bass, drums, guitar, vocals, synthesizer, piano
about: Toro y Moi's seventh studio album and his first on Dead Oceans, self-produced by Chaz Bear. Named after a Tagalog word meaning love or expensive, it draws on his Filipino heritage and a car theme inspired by jeepneys, in a psychedelic funk style.

title: Illmatic
label: Get On Down
about: Nas's debut studio album, released by Columbia with production from DJ Premier, Pete Rock, Large Professor, Q-Tip and others. Recorded in New York in 1992 and 1993, it entered the Billboard 200 at number 12 and is widely regarded as a hip-hop landmark.

title: A Beautiful Time
label: Legacy
personnel: Trigger Barry Bales, Kevin "Swine" Grant – upright bass
Jim "Moose" Brown, Catherine Marx – piano, B-3 organ, synthesizer
Buddy Cannon, Melonie Cannon – background vocals
Chad Cromwell, Fred Eltringham, Lonnie Wilson – drums
Bobby Terry – acoustic guitar, electric guitar, steel guitar, bass, piano

tracks.t: I'll Love You Till The Day I Die
We're Not Happy (Till You're Not Happy)
With A Little Help From My Friends

about: A solo studio album by Willie Nelson, produced by Buddy Cannon and released on Legacy around his 89th birthday. Critics praised it strongly, and it won the Grammy Award for Best Country Album.

title: Signing Off
label: Virgin EMI Records
personnel: Ali Campbell – lead vocals, rhythm guitar

tracks.t: I Think It's Going To Rain Today

about: UB40's first album, released by the independent Graduate label and largely recorded in producer Bob Lamb's Birmingham flat. Mixing reggae and dub with politically pointed lyrics, it reached number 2 in the UK and went platinum.

title: A Different Kind Of Tension
label: Domino
personnel: Pete Shelley – guitar (left channel), vocals, keyboards

tracks.t: You Say You Don't Love Me
You Know You Can't Help It
I Don't Know What To Do With My Life

about: The third Buzzcocks studio album, produced by Martin Rushent and recorded at Eden Studios in London. It peaked at number 26 in the UK and featured the singles You Say You Don't Love Me and I Believe.

title: Folk Singer
label: Analogue Productions
personnel: Buddy Guy, Sammy Lawhorn, James Madison – guitar
Otis Spann – harmonica, piano Francis Clay, Clifton James, S.P

tracks.t: My Home Is In The Delta

about: Muddy Waters's only fully acoustic album, recorded in Chicago in 1963 for Chess with Willie Dixon on bass and Buddy Guy on second guitar. It did not chart but became a well-regarded blues record, later listed among Rolling Stone's greatest albums.

title: 45,000 Volts
label: Now-Again Records
personnel: Tommy Mwale – bass guitar, backing vocals
Chrissy Zebby Tembo – drums, backing vocals
about: A Zamrock album by Zambian band the Ngozi Family, led by guitarist and singer Paul Ngozi. It was recorded at Sapra Studio in Nairobi and first issued on Chris Editions, and has since been reissued for international audiences.

title: Introduction
label: Now-Again Records

tracks.t: I've Been Away For Too Long

about: The first album by the Zambian rock group Witch, issued in 1972 during the early Zamrock era. It mixes garage and psychedelic rock with local influences and was reissued internationally in 2011.

title: Lazy Bones!!
label: Now-Again Records
about: Witch's third album, released in Zambia in 1975. It is regarded as one of the band's heavier Zamrock records, blending fuzz guitar rock with funk, and it was reissued for overseas audiences in 2012.

title: Day of Judgment
label: Now-Again Records
personnel: Tommy Mwale – bass guitar, backing vocals
Chrissy Zebby Tembo – drums, backing vocals
Paul "Ngozi" Nyirongo – lead guitar, lead vocals
Peter Bwalya – rhythm guitar, backing vocals

tracks.t: We Wonna Give It To Her

about: The 1976 debut by the Ngozi Family, the Zambian group led by guitarist and singer Paul Ngozi. Its raw, distorted sound combines hard rock and funk with Zambian rhythms, and it has been reissued by Now-Again Records.

title: Let It Be Blue
label: Warp Records
personnel: Nic Offer – vocals, keyboards, drum programming
Rafael Cohen – vocals, guitar, bass, keyboards, drum programming
Mario Andreoni – guitar, bass, keyboards, drum programming

tracks.t: Here's What I Need To Know

about: The ninth album by New York dance-punk band !!!, put out by Warp Records in May 2022. It leans toward a 1990s rave and breakbeat feel and closes with a disco reworking of R.E.M.'s Man on the Moon.

title: Standing On The Verge Of Getting It On
label: Westbound Records

tracks.t: Standing On The Verge Of Getting It On
Jimmy's Got A Little Bit Of Bitch In Him

about: Funkadelic's sixth studio album, issued by Westbound in July 1974 and produced by George Clinton. It saw guitarist Eddie Hazel return to the group and reached number 13 on the R&B albums chart.

title: Camp
label: Glassnote
personnel: Donald Glover – design, drum programming, producer, programming, string arrangements, vocals
Ludwig Göransson – drum programming, engineer, guitar, keyboards, producer, programming
about: Donald Glover's first studio album as Childish Gambino, released by Glassnote in November 2011 and co-produced with Ludwig Goransson. The hip-hop record peaked at number 11 on the Billboard 200 and yielded the single Bonfire.

title: Boxer
label: Beggars Banquet
personnel: Aaron Dessner – guitar, backing vocals, keyboards, piano, percussion
about: The fourth studio album by indie rock band The National, released on Beggars Banquet in May 2007. Produced with Peter Katis, it includes Fake Empire and Mistaken for Strangers and drew strong critical praise.

title: Life Is Yours
label: Warner Records
about: Foals' seventh studio album, released in June 2022 and the first made by the band as a trio. Its upbeat dance-rock and disco sound reached number 3 in the UK, and a dub version followed in 2023.

title: Are You Experienced?
label: Analogue Productions
personnel: Noel Redding – bass guitar; backing vocals; rhythm guitar
Mitch Mitchell – drums; percussion; backing vocals
about: The first album by the Jimi Hendrix Experience, issued in the UK by Track Records in May 1967 and in the US that August. Produced by Chas Chandler, it reached number 2 in Britain and became a landmark of psychedelic rock.

title: Time
label: Jet Records
personnel: Jeff Lynne – Lead and backing vocals, electric and acoustic guitars, piano, synthesizers, vocoder, production
Richard Tandy – Acoustic and electric pianos, synthesizers, vocoder, guitars
Kelly Groucutt – Bass guitar, backing vocals

tracks.t: The Way Life's Meant To Be
From The End Of The World

about: Electric Light Orchestra's ninth studio album, a 1981 concept record produced by Jeff Lynne about a man transported to the year 2095. Its synth-driven sound topped the UK chart and it includes Hold On Tight.

title: Escape
label: Columbia
personnel: Neal Schon – lead guitar, backing vocals
Jonathan Cain – keyboards, rhythm guitar, backing vocals
about: Journey's seventh studio album and the first with keyboardist Jonathan Cain, released by Columbia in July 1981. It hit number 1 in the US, contains Don't Stop Believin' and Open Arms, and later earned Diamond certification.

title: American Fool
label: Riva
personnel: John Mellencamp – lead vocals, guitar, tambourine
Larry Crane, Mike Wanchic, Mick Ronson – guitar, vocals
about: John Mellencamp's 1982 breakthrough, credited to John Cougar and released on Riva. Driven by Hurts So Good and Jack & Diane, it spent nine weeks at number 1 on the Billboard 200.

title: The Story Of Star Wars
label: 20th Century Fox Records

tracks.t: The Story Of Star Wars (Part One)
The Story Of Star Wars (Part Two)

about: A 1977 audio drama LP from 20th Century Fox Records that condenses the first Star Wars film using its dialogue, music and effects, with narration by Roscoe Lee Browne. It came with a photo booklet and went gold.

title: NBC's Saturday Night Live
label: Arista

about: An Arista LP gathering sketches and bits from the early seasons of NBC's Saturday Night Live. It features the original cast, including Chevy Chase, John Belushi and Gilda Radner, alongside guest hosts such as Richard Pryor and Lily Tomlin.

title: Comedy Is Not Pretty!
label: Warner Bros. Records
about: Steve Martin's third comedy album, released in 1979 and recorded live at The Boarding House in San Francisco. It followed A Wild and Crazy Guy and preceded The Steve Martin Brothers.

title: A Wild And Crazy Guy
label: Warner Bros. Records

tracks.t: Creativity In Action / I'm In The Mood For Love

about: Steve Martin's second comedy album, issued by Warner Bros. in October 1978 and recorded at San Francisco's Boarding House and at Red Rocks. It reached number 2 on the pop albums chart and won the Grammy for Best Comedy Album.

title: Talking Back To The Night
label: Island Records
personnel: Steve Winwood – lead and backing vocals, Prophet-5, Hammond B3, Linn LM-1 programming, percussion
about: Steve Winwood's third solo studio album, released by Island in August 1982. Winwood produced it himself and played every instrument at his Gloucestershire home studio; it includes the single Valerie and reached number 6 in the UK.

title: The Magic Of ABBA
label: K-Tel

tracks.t: I Do, I Do, I Do, I Do, I Do

about: A 1980 hits collection of ABBA songs marketed in the United States by K-tel. It gathers sixteen of the Swedish group's well-known tracks, such as Waterloo, SOS and Take a Chance on Me.

title: Live In The City Of Light
label: A&M Records
about: Simple Minds' first live album, a double set released by Virgin in May 1987. Most of it was captured at Le Zenith in Paris in August 1986 at the end of their Once Upon a Time tour, and it topped the UK chart.

title: Greatest Hits
label: MCA Records

tracks.t: Don't Let The Sun Go Down On Me

about: Elton John's first hits compilation, released in November 1974 and covering his 1970 to 1974 recordings. It reached number 1 in both the US and UK and became his best-selling album in America.

title: Especially For You
label: Enigma
personnel: Dennis Diken – drums, percussion, backing vocals
Mike Mesaros – bass guitar, backing vocals

tracks.t: I Don't Want To Lose You

about: The Smithereens' first full-length album, issued by Enigma in 1986 and produced by Don Dixon. The power pop record features Blood and Roses and Behind the Wall of Sleep and peaked at number 51 in the US.

title: Green Thoughts
label: Warner Bros Records
personnel: Dennis Diken – drums, percussion, backing vocals
Mike Mesaros – bass guitar, backing vocals

tracks.t: House We Used To Live In

about: The Smithereens' second studio album, recorded at Capitol Studios with producer Don Dixon and released in March 1988. Its lead single Only a Memory went to number 1 on the album rock tracks chart.

title: Tracy Chapman
label: Elektra
personnel: Tracy Chapman – acoustic guitar, percussion, rhythm guitar, vocals
about: Tracy Chapman's debut album, released by Elektra in April 1988 and produced by David Kershenbaum. Powered by Fast Car, it topped the US chart, sold millions worldwide and won three Grammy Awards.

title: Dusty in Memphis
label: Analogue Productions

tracks.t: I Don't Want To Hear It Anymore
In The Land Of Make Believe

about: Dusty Springfield's 1969 album for Atlantic, cut largely in Memphis with producers Jerry Wexler, Arif Mardin and Tom Dowd. It sold modestly at first but is now widely praised and includes Son of a Preacher Man.

title: Rhythm Revolution
label: Acid Jazz

tracks.t: When I Come In The Road
My Dad Has Me To Kanm

about: A mid-1970s Afrobeat and funk album by Beninese bandleader Ferry Djimmy and his group the Dji-Kins, recorded in Cotonou. Original copies are very rare, and Acid Jazz reissued it with bonus single tracks in 2022.

artist: Al Di Meola, John McLaughlin & Paco De Lucía
title: Saturday Night in San Francisco
label: Impex Records

tracks.t: Splendido Sundance Al Di Meola / The Trio
Monasterio De Sal Paco De Lucía
El Pañuelo Paco De Lucía / The Trio
Meeting Of The Spirits John McLaughlin / The Trio

about: A concert by guitarists Al Di Meola, John McLaughlin and Paco de Lucia recorded at the Warfield Theatre on 6 December 1980, a night after the Friday Night in San Francisco show. Long believed lost, it was issued by Earmusic in 2022.
artistKey: Al Di Meola, John McLaughlin & Paco De Lucía

title: Ready To Die
label: Bad Boy Entertainment
about: The Notorious B.I.G.'s first studio album, issued on Bad Boy Records with production led by Sean Combs. It mixes autobiographical crime narratives with hits such as Juicy, was the only album he released while alive, and is credited with reviving East Coast hip-hop.

title: Alchemy: Dire Straits Live
label: Warner Bros. Records

tracks.t: Once Upon A Time In The West

about: Dire Straits' first live record, a double album taken from two July 1983 shows at London's Hammersmith Odeon at the end of the Love Over Gold tour. Many songs are stretched out with new arrangements and long instrumental passages.

title: Special
label: Nice Life
about: Lizzo's fourth studio album, released by Nice Life and Atlantic and led by the single About Damn Time. It drew mostly favorable reviews and opened at number two on the Billboard 200, her best chart debut up to that point.

title: Animals (2018 Remix)
label: Pink Floyd Records
about: Pink Floyd's tenth studio album, a concept record loosely modeled on Orwell's Animal Farm that portrays 1970s British society as dogs, pigs and sheep. Reviews were mixed at first, but it reached the top three in the UK and US and is now widely admired; a new remix appeared in 2018.

title: Surrender
label: Rose Avenue
about: The fourth studio album by Australian electronic trio Rüfüs Du Sol, supported by four singles. It received ARIA nominations and a Grammy nomination for Best Dance/Electronic Album.

title: Play
label: Little Idiot

tracks.t: Why Does My Heart Feel So Bad?

about: Moby's fifth studio album, released on Mute and V2, built electronic tracks around vintage blues and gospel samples, many from Alan Lomax field recordings. Slow sales at first gave way to global success after every track was licensed for film, TV and ads, with sales above 12 million.

title: B'Day
label: Sony Urban Music
about: Beyoncé's second solo studio album, following Dangerously in Love and shaped partly by her work on the film Dreamgirls. It blends R&B, funk and hip hop, was well reviewed, and debuted at the top of the Billboard 200.

title: Checkerboard Lounge Live Chicago
label: Warner Bros Records

tracks.t: You're Gonna Miss Me When I'm Gone

about: A concert film and live album capturing a November 1981 night at Chicago's Checkerboard Lounge, where Mick Jagger, Keith Richards and Ronnie Wood joined Muddy Waters and his band on stage. Eagle Vision issued it in 2012.

title: GI - (M.I.A.) The Complete Anthology
label: Porterhouse Records
about: A 1993 CD anthology from Slash Records gathering the Los Angeles punk band Germs' recordings, including the whole of their sole studio album (GI) from 1979, which Joan Jett produced and which is often called the first full-length hardcore punk record.

title: Rust Never Sleeps
label: Reprise Records

tracks.t: My My, Hey Hey (Out Of The Blue)
Hey Hey, My My (Into The Black)

about: Neil Young's tenth studio album and his third with Crazy Horse, mixing concert recordings with studio overdubs and new studio tracks. One side is mostly acoustic and the other loud and electric; it reached number eight in the US and includes Powderfinger.

title: Santana III
label: Columbia Records
personnel: Michael P. R. Carabello – congas, vocals, percussion, tambourine
Jose Chepito Areas – timbales, congas, percussion, vocals, drums, flugelhorn
about: Santana's third studio album, issued by Columbia and often seen as the band's creative and commercial high point. It yielded the singles Everybody's Everything and No One to Depend On and was the final record by the Woodstock-era lineup until a 2016 reunion.

title: Synchronicity
label: A&M Records
about: The Police's fifth and last studio album, released by A&M and the band's most successful record. It topped the charts in the UK and US, won three Grammys and was praised for its stylistic range.
cdNote: CD listed in your My CDs playlist

title: Plastic Letters
label: Chrysalis
personnel: James Destri – grand piano, organ, synthesizer, strings, backing vocals
Frank "The Freak" Infante – bass, rhythm guitar
Chris Stein – lead guitar, bass, vibraphone

tracks.t: (I'm Always Touched By Your) Presence Dear
I Didn't Have The Nerve To Say No

about: Blondie's second studio album, produced by Richard Gottehrer for Chrysalis. Its version of Denise, renamed Denis, became a UK number two hit, and the album reached the UK top ten and went platinum there.

title: At The Royal Albert Hall (April 14, 1970)
label: Fantasy
personnel: John Fogerty – lead guitar, lead vocals, harmonica
Tom Fogerty – rhythm guitar, backing vocals

tracks.t: The Night Time Is The Right Time

about: A 2022 release documenting Creedence Clearwater Revival's full London concert of 14 April 1970 during their first European tour. It came out alongside the documentary Travelin' Band; an earlier 1980 album once sold under this concert's name had actually been recorded in Oakland.

title: Is This Desire? - Demos
label: Island Records
about: A 2021 release from UMe and Island collecting twelve previously unissued PJ Harvey demos, one for each song on her 1998 album Is This Desire?. It appeared on CD, vinyl and digital formats alongside a reissue of the original album.

title: Check Your Head
label: Capitol Records
personnel: Mark Ramos-Nishita – clavinet, electric piano, keyboards, organ

tracks.t: Pass The Mic (Pt. 2, Skills To Pay The Bills)
The Skills To Pay The Bills (Original Version)
So What' Cha Want (Soul Assassin Remix Version)
So What' Cha Want (Butt Naked Version)
Stand Together (Live At French's Tavern, Sydney Australia)
So What' Cha Want (All The Way Live Freestyle Version)

about: The Beastie Boys' third studio album, released on Grand Royal and Capitol, saw the trio return to playing live instruments after the sample-based Paul's Boutique. It reached number ten in the US and was later certified double platinum.

title: This Year's Model
label: UMe

tracks.t: I Don’t Want To Go To Chelsea

about: Elvis Costello's second studio album and his first with the Attractions, produced by Nick Lowe. Drawing on new wave, punk and power pop, it reached number four in the UK and is often ranked among his best work.
cdNote: CD listed in your My CDs playlist

title: Blood On The Tracks
label: Columbia
personnel: Bob Dylan – vocals, harmonica, acoustic guitar

tracks.t: You're Gonna Make Me Lonesome When You Go
Lily, Rosemary & The Jack Of Hearts
If You See Her, Say Hello

about: Bob Dylan's fifteenth studio album, marking his return to Columbia after a brief stint with Asylum. Its songs are frequently linked to the breakdown of his marriage, a reading Dylan rejected, and it is now regarded as one of his finest records.
cdNote: CD listed in your My CDs playlist

title: Blue
label: Reprise Records

tracks.t: The Last Time I Saw Richard

about: Joni Mitchell's fourth studio album, which she wrote and produced for Reprise. Built on spare arrangements of acoustic guitar, piano and dulcimer, it examines love from many angles and is commonly considered her masterpiece.

title: Stories From The City, Stories From The Sea
label: Island Records

tracks.t: The Whores Hustle And The Hustlers Whore

about: PJ Harvey's fifth studio album, released by Island and shaped by her time in New York, focuses on romantic love. It sold strongly, won the 2001 Mercury Prize and is frequently cited as one of her strongest records.

artist: Al Di Meola, John McLaughlin & Paco De Lucía
title: Friday Night In San Francisco
label: Impex Records

tracks.t: Short Tales Of The Black Forest

about: A live acoustic guitar album by Al Di Meola, John McLaughlin and Paco de Lucía, mostly taped at San Francisco's Warfield Theatre in December 1980. It is widely regarded as one of the most influential acoustic guitar recordings.
artistKey: Al Di Meola, John McLaughlin & Paco De Lucía

title: Return Of The Dream Canteen
label: Warner Records

tracks.t: La La La La La La La La

about: Red Hot Chili Peppers' thirteenth studio album, produced by Rick Rubin and drawn from the same sessions as Unlimited Love earlier that year. It debuted at number one in six countries and at number three in the US.

title: Alive 2007
label: Atlantic
about: Daft Punk's second live album, recorded at their June 2007 show at Paris-Bercy during the Alive tour, where their songs were reworked into mashed-up medleys. It won the 2009 Grammy for Best Electronic/Dance Album.

title: Heroes
label: Parlophone
about: David Bowie's twelfth studio album and the middle entry of his Berlin trilogy, recorded mostly in West Berlin with Brian Eno and Tony Visconti. It was a UK top three hit, though critics often consider Low the more groundbreaking work.

title: Fresh Fruit For Rotting Vegetables - 2022 Mix
label: Manifesto
about: Dead Kennedys' first studio album, originally issued by Cherry Red and I.R.S., with a cover photo of police cars burning in the 1979 White Night riots. A full remix by Chris Lord-Alge came out in 2022, which Jello Biafra publicly opposed.

title: Yankee Hotel Foxtrot
label: Nonesuch

tracks.t: I Am Trying To Break Your Heart
I'm The Man Who Loves You

about: Wilco's fourth studio album, made amid lineup turmoil and mixed largely by Jim O'Rourke. After Reprise declined to release it, the band streamed it online in 2001 and later issued it through Nonesuch in 2002, and it became their most acclaimed and best-selling album.

title: The Bends
label: XL Recordings
personnel: Jon Greenwood – guitar, organ, recorder, synthesizer, piano
about: Radiohead's second record, produced mainly by John Leckie, moved the band toward broader guitar rock with more emotional songwriting. It reached number four in Britain, yielded singles such as Fake Plastic Trees and Street Spirit (Fade Out), and later earned wide critical acclaim.

title: Life After Death
label: Bad Boy Entertainment
about: The Notorious B.I.G.'s second and final studio album, a double-disc set issued about two weeks after he was killed. It featured hits including Hypnotize and Mo Money Mo Problems, topped the Billboard 200 and became one of the best-selling hip-hop records ever.

title: San Francisco Days
label: Sun

tracks.t: Can't Do A Thing (To Stop Me)

about: Chris Isaak's fourth album, produced by Erik Jacobsen for Reprise, has a livelier feel than its predecessor Heart Shaped World. It sold less than that record but still went gold in the US, and it was his last with guitarist James Calvin Wilsey.

title: Brothers In Arms
label: Warner Records
about: Dire Straits' fifth album, produced by Mark Knopfler with Neil Dorfsman, became the band's commercial peak. Driven by singles like Money for Nothing and Walk of Life, it topped charts in many countries and was an early landmark of the compact disc era.

title: Tommy
label: Polydor
about: A double album and pioneering rock opera, mostly written by Pete Townshend, about a deaf, mute and blind boy who becomes a pinball champion and messianic figure. The Who's fourth album was acclaimed on release and climbed to number two in the UK.

title: Root Down EP
label: Capitol Records
about: A Capitol EP by Beastie Boys pairing three versions of Root Down, a track from Ill Communication, with songs recorded live during their European tour in early 1995. It charted at number 23 in the UK and number 50 in the US.

title: Honeysuckle Rose (Original Soundtrack)
label: Columbia
