about: Elton John's fifth studio album, released in May 1972 and named for the French chateau where it was recorded. It reached the top of the US Billboard 200, beginning a run of seven straight American number-one albums for him, and is often counted among his strongest work.

title: Goodbye Yellow Brick Road
label: MCA Records

tracks.t: Your Sister Can't Twist (But She Can Rock 'N' Roll)

about: Elton John's seventh studio album, a double LP issued in October 1973 and largely recorded at the Chateau d'Herouville in France. It topped both the British and American album charts and features well-known songs such as Bennie and the Jets and Candle in the Wind.

title: Don't Shoot Me I'm Only The Piano Player
label: MCA Special Markets
about: Elton John's sixth studio album, produced by Gus Dudgeon, recorded in France and released in January 1973. It went to number one in both the UK and the US, helped by the hit singles Crocodile Rock and Daniel.

title: Caribou
label: MCA Records

tracks.t: Don't Let The Sun Go Down On Me

about: Elton John's eighth studio album, issued in June 1974 in the US and days later in Britain. It reached number one on both sides of the Atlantic and included the singles The Bitch Is Back and Don't Let the Sun Go Down on Me, though critics were lukewarm.

title: Too Low For Zero
label: Geffen Records

tracks.t: Cold As Christmas (In The Middle Of The Year)
I Guess That's Why They Call It The Blues

about: Elton John's seventeenth studio album, produced by Chris Thomas and released in May 1983. Regarded as a commercial comeback after several weaker records, it went platinum in the US and UK and produced several hits, including I Guess That's Why They Call It the Blues.

title: Elvis' Golden Records
label: RCA Victor

tracks.t: Anyway You Want Me (That's How I Will Be)
I Want You, I Need You, I Love You

about: An RCA Victor collection of Elvis Presley's hit singles from 1956 and 1957, released in March 1958 and often described as rock and roll's first greatest hits album. It peaked at number three on the Billboard pop albums chart and later earned multi-platinum certification.

title: Elvis' Golden Records Volume 3
label: RCA Victor
about: The third entry in RCA Victor's Golden Records series, released in August 1963 and gathering Elvis Presley's hit singles from 1960 through 1962. It climbed to number three on the Billboard pop albums chart and was certified gold and then platinum.

title: Live 1969
notes: Songs listed are the ones in your Spotify playlist; the full tracklist is not on Discogs.

tracks.t: All Shook Up - Live at The International Hotel, Las Vegas, NV - 8/21/69 Midnight Show
Love Me Tender - Live at The International Hotel, Las Vegas, NV - 8/21/69 Midnight Show
Medley: Jailhouse Rock / Don't Be Cruel - Live at The International Hotel, Las Vegas, NV - 8/21/69 Midnight Show
Heartbreak Hotel - Live at The International Hotel, Las Vegas, NV - 8/21/69 Midnight Show
Blue Suede Shoes - Live at The International Hotel, Las Vegas, NV - 8/22/69 Dinner Show

about: An 11-CD box set issued by Sony Music/RCA in August 2019 to mark fifty years since Elvis Presley's comeback engagement at the International Hotel in Las Vegas. It presents eleven complete shows recorded between August 21 and 26, 1969, with an accompanying illustrated book.

title: 13 Songs
label: Dischord Records
about: A Dischord Records release combining all tracks from Fugazi's first two EPs, the self-titled Fugazi and Margin Walker. Issued in September 1989, it is the Washington, D.C. post-hardcore band's best-selling title.

title: All Things Must Pass
label: Apple Records

tracks.t: Ballad Of Sir Frankie Crisp (Let It Roll)

about: George Harrison's third studio album and his first solo release after the Beatles split, issued as a triple LP on Apple in November 1970. Co-produced with Phil Spector, it was a major critical and commercial success and included the singles My Sweet Lord and What Is Life.

title: Pearl
label: Columbia
about: Janis Joplin's second and final solo studio album, released by Columbia in January 1971, roughly three months after her death. Her only record with the Full Tilt Boogie Band, it reached number one on the Billboard 200 and went quadruple platinum.

title: The Long Goodbye (LCD Soundsystem Live At Madison Square Garden)
label: Warner Bros. Records
personnel: James Murphy – producer, vocals, percussion, organ, kalimba, synthesizer, piano
Al Doyle – guitar, vocals, percussion, synthesizer, bass guitar, clavinet, trumpet, organ, glockenspiel
Gavin Russom – synthesizer, percussion, piano, electric piano, clavinet, vocals, vocoder
Nancy Whang – synthesizer, vocals, piano, organ, sampler, electric piano

tracks.t: Daft Punk Is Playing At My House
New York, I Love You But You're Bringing Me Down

about: A live recording of LCD Soundsystem's 2011 Madison Square Garden concert, then billed as the band's farewell show before their later reunion. It first appeared as a limited five-LP box set for Record Store Day 2014 and runs over three hours.

title: Spring Session M
label: Capitol Records
personnel: Patrick O'Hearn – bass, electric bass, synthesizer

tracks.t: It Ain't None Of Your Business

about: The first full-length album by American new wave band Missing Persons, produced by Ken Scott and released by Capitol in October 1982. It received generally positive reviews, peaked at number 17 on the Billboard 200 and was certified gold.

title: Pastel Blues
label: Philips

tracks.t: Nobody Knows You When You're Down And Out
Tell Me More And More And Then Some

about: A Nina Simone studio album recorded in New York in 1964 and 1965 and released by Philips in October 1965. It charted on the Billboard 200 and reached the top ten of the R&B albums chart, and it has since appeared on critics' lists of the decade's best records.

title: Nina Simone Sings The Blues
label: RCA Victor

tracks.t: I Want A Little Sugar In My Bowl
The House Of The Rising Sun

about: Nina Simone's first album for RCA Victor, recorded in New York between late 1966 and early 1967 and released that June. The set blends blues with soul, jazz, folk and pop influences and includes her take on Gershwin's My Man's Gone Now.

title: 'Nuff Said!
label: RCA Victor

tracks.t: Why? (The King of Love Is Dead)
Ain't Got No I Got Life

about: A 1968 RCA Victor album by Nina Simone, mostly taken from an April 1968 concert at the Westbury Music Fair held days after the assassination of Martin Luther King Jr. and dedicated to him. Three studio tracks were added, among them Ain't Got No, I Got Life, a big European hit.

title: Organisation
label: Virgin
about: The second studio album by English synth-pop group Orchestral Manoeuvres in the Dark, released on Dindisc in October 1980. Produced by Mike Howlett, their first outside producer, it was well reviewed and became the band's first top-ten album in the UK.

title: Warm, In Your Coat
label: Columbia

tracks.t: A Girl In Trouble (Is A Temporary Thing)

about: A 1992 Columbia Records retrospective of the San Francisco band Romeo Void, drawing on material recorded from 1980 to 1984. It also contains a previously unissued song, One Thousand Shadows.

title: Country Willie - His Own Songs
label: RCA Victor

tracks.t: Darkness On The Face Of The Earth

about: Willie Nelson's third studio album and first for RCA Victor, produced in Nashville by Chet Atkins. It mostly revisits songs he had already written for others, adding a few new ones, in lush orchestral and choral settings that were later judged ill-suited to his style.

title: Across The Borderline
label: Columbia

tracks.t: I Love The Life I Live
If You Were The Man You Wanted
Still Is Still Moving To Me

about: Willie Nelson's 40th studio album, released by Columbia in March 1993 with production by Don Was, Paul Simon and Roy Halee. It features guest appearances from artists including Paul Simon, Bonnie Raitt, Sinead O'Connor and Bob Dylan.

title: We Intend To Cause Havoc!
label: Now-Again Records

tracks.t: I Like The Way I Am

about: A multi-disc Now-Again Records anthology of the 1970s Zambian rock band WITCH, compiled by Eothen Alapatt. It collects the group's original albums along with bonus tracks and singles, issued as a box set on both CD and vinyl.

title: Collection
label: Caroline Records
about: A 1986 compilation, officially titled Misfits but widely known as Collection I, released by Caroline and Plan 9. It gathers twenty tracks by the New Jersey horror punk band from earlier singles and albums, and was later followed by Collection II.

title: Born To Be
label: Buddah Records
about: The first studio album by American singer-songwriter Melanie, issued by Buddah Records in late 1968. Following her Woodstock appearance, the label reissued it under the title My First Album; critical reaction was mixed.

title: Leftover Wine
label: Buddah Records
about: A 1970 Buddah Records live album by Melanie, recorded at Carnegie Hall in New York with the singer accompanying herself on acoustic guitar. Its final track, Peace Will Come (According to Plan), is a studio recording issued as a single to promote the record.

title: Funeral
label: Merge Records
personnel: Régine Chassagne – accordion, double bass, drums, percussion, piano, synthesizer, vocals, xylophone
Win Butler – acoustic guitar, bass, guitar, piano, synthesizer, vocals
Richard Reed Parry – accordion, double bass, guitar, organ, percussion, piano, synthesizer, xylophone
Timothy Kingsbury – acoustic guitar, bass, guitar
William Butler – bass, percussion, synthesizer, xylophone
about: Arcade Fire's first full-length record, issued by Merge and largely recorded at Hotel2Tango in Montreal. Its name reflects several deaths in band members' families during the sessions. It earned a Grammy nomination and is widely ranked among the defining indie rock albums of the 2000s.

title: Pass In Time: The Definitive Collection
label: Heavenly

tracks.t: I Wish I Never Saw The Sunshine

about: A two-disc career retrospective from Beth Orton on Heavenly Records, drawing on her first three albums and singles plus one new track. The second disc gathers collaborations, remixes and B-sides, including work with the Chemical Brothers and William Orbit. It reached the UK top 50 and was certified Silver.

title: No Exit
label: Beyond
personnel: Theo From The Lunachicks – backing vocals

tracks.t: Nothing Is Real But The Girl
Boom Boom In The Zoom Zoom Room

about: Blondie's reunion record, arriving seventeen years after their previous album and produced by Craig Leon. It mixes pop, ska, country, jazz and hip-hop influences. The single Maria topped the UK chart, and the album reached number three in Britain.

tracks.t: Baby, I'm In The Mood For You
Can You Please Crawl Out Your Window?
I Don't Believe You (She Acts Like We Never Have Met) (Live)

title: X&Y
label: Capitol Records
about: Coldplay's third album, made over a difficult year of sessions and split into X and Y halves. It went to number one in dozens of countries and was the top-selling album worldwide in 2005. Singles included Speed of Sound and Fix You.

title: Come Fly With Me
label: Capitol Records

tracks.t: Let's Get Away From It All

about: A Capitol concept record framed as a musical journey around the globe, marking Frank Sinatra's first pairing with arranger Billy May. It held the top spot on the Billboard album chart for five weeks and was nominated for Album of the Year at the first Grammy Awards.

title: Genesis
label: Atlantic
about: The self-titled Genesis album, the first the trio wrote, recorded and mixed entirely at their Surrey studio, The Farm, with Hugh Padgham co-producing. It topped the UK chart, went four times platinum in the US and featured the singles Mama and That's All.

title: Dreamboat Annie
label: Capitol Records

tracks.t: (Love Me Like Music) I'll Be Your Song

about: Heart's first album, recorded in Vancouver and first issued in Canada by Mushroom Records before a US release in early 1976. Driven by Magic Man and Crazy on You, it reached the US top ten and went platinum.

title: Little Queen
label: Portrait
about: Heart's first release on Portrait Records, recorded in Seattle amid a legal fight with their former label Mushroom. It contains Barracuda, peaked inside the US top ten and eventually sold triple platinum in America.

title: Heart
label: Capitol Records
personnel: Nancy Wilson – lead guitar, acoustic guitar, mandolin, backing vocals
Howard Leese – lead guitar, keyboards, mandolin, backing vocals
about: Heart's self-titled Capitol debut, produced by Ron Nevison and built largely on outside songwriters. It became the band's only US number-one album, sold five million copies there and yielded their first chart-topping single, These Dreams.

title: Bad Animals
label: Capitol Records
personnel: Ann Wilson – backing vocals, lead vocals
Howard Leese – backing vocals, guitar, keyboards
Nancy Wilson – backing vocals, guitar, keyboards
about: A polished hard rock follow-up to Heart's 1985 comeback, again produced by Ron Nevison for Capitol. Led by the US number-one single Alone, it climbed to number two on the Billboard 200 and went triple platinum.

title: Brigade
label: Capitol Records
personnel: Nancy Wilson – guitar, acoustic guitar, backing vocals, harmonica, keyboards, mandolin
Howard Leese – guitar, backing vocals, keyboards, mandolin

tracks.t: All I Wanna Do Is Make Love To You
I Didn't Want To Need You
I Want Your World To Turn

about: Heart's 1990 Capitol release, produced by Richie Zito. It peaked at number three in both the US and UK, helped by the hit All I Wanna Do Is Make Love to You, and was backed by a large world tour.

title: Songs You Know By Heart: Jimmy Buffett's Greatest Hit(s)
label: MCA Records

tracks.t: Son Of A Son Of A Sailor
Changes In Latitudes, Changes In Attitudes

about: Jimmy Buffett's first hits package on MCA, drawn entirely from his 1970s recordings. Though it only reached number 100 on release, steady sales made it his biggest seller, certified seven times platinum, and it returned to the chart top five after his death in 2023.

title: Live in New York
label: Nonesuch
about: A double-CD concert recording made at New York's Town Hall on 19 and 20 September 2001, days after the September 11 attacks. Laurie Anderson performs a blend of earlier and newer pieces; the cover bears the title Live at Town Hall New York City.

title: The Little Willies
label: Milking Bull Records

tracks.t: I'll Never Get Out Of This World Alive

about: The first record by the country side project featuring Norah Jones, produced by Lee Alexander. It mostly covers songs associated with Hank Williams, Willie Nelson, Townes Van Zandt and Kris Kristofferson, alongside a few originals, and reached the top ten of the US country albums chart.

title: The Emancipation of Mimi
label: Island Records
about: Mariah Carey's Island Records album regarded as her commercial comeback after two weaker releases. Featuring We Belong Together, a long-running US number one, it was America's best-selling album of 2005 and won three Grammy Awards.

title: Youth
label: Epic
about: The Hasidic reggae artist's second studio set, produced chiefly by Bill Laswell. Its lyrics draw on Jewish faith and urge young people to speak out. It entered the Billboard 200 at number four and went gold within weeks.

title: Don't Believe The Truth
label: Epic
about: Oasis's sixth album, produced by Dave Sardy with Noel Gallagher and featuring songwriting from several band members. It went to number one in Britain and generated the singles Lyla, The Importance of Being Idle and Let There Be Love.

title: Wave of Mutilation: Best of Pixies
label: 4AD
about: A 4AD hits collection of 23 Pixies tracks from 1987 to 1991, issued around the band's reunion and replacing Death to the Pixies as the label's main overview. A companion DVD offered live footage, videos and documentaries.

title: Greatest Hits
label: A&M Records

tracks.t: The Bed's Too Big Without You
Don't Stand So Close To Me
De Do Do Do De Da Da Da
Every Little Thing She Does Is Magic

about: The Police's second hits compilation on A&M, collecting sixteen Sting-written songs including singles left off the earlier Every Breath You Take collection. It reached number ten in the UK and topped the New Zealand chart.

title: A Bigger Bang
label: Virgin

tracks.t: Look What The Cat Dragged In

about: The Rolling Stones' first studio record since 1997, largely cut by Jagger, Richards and Watts as a trio with Don Was co-producing. The back-to-basics hard rock set reached number two in the UK and three in the US, and launched a major world tour.

title: RUN-DMC
label: Profile Records
about: Run-D.M.C.'s first album on Profile Records, produced by Russell Simmons and Larry Smith. It became the first rap album certified gold, and Rock Box is often cited as the earliest rap rock track.

title: All That I Am
label: Arista

tracks.t: I Don't Wanna Lose Your Love

about: Santana's Arista album produced by Clive Davis, continuing the guest-heavy formula of its two predecessors with artists such as Steven Tyler, Michelle Branch and Joss Stone. It debuted at number two in the US but drew largely negative reviews.

title: Wildflower
label: A&M Records

tracks.t: Where Has All The Love Gone

about: Sheryl Crow's fifth studio record, produced by Crow with Jeff Trott and John Shanks. It reached number two on the Billboard 200 and topped the Canadian chart, with Good Is Good, Perfect Lie and Always on Your Side issued as singles.

title: The Sky Is Crying
label: Epic
personnel: Stevie Ray Vaughan – guitar, vocals, producer

tracks.t: May I Have A Talk With You

about: Posthumous Stevie Ray Vaughan and Double Trouble release assembled by Jimmie Vaughan from mostly unissued studio recordings made between 1984 and 1989. It became Vaughan's highest-charting album at number ten in the US, and its take on Little Wing earned a Grammy for rock instrumental performance.

title: Suzanne Vega
label: A&M Records
about: Suzanne Vega's first album, a folk rock set issued by A&M and produced by Steve Addabbo and Lenny Kaye. Marlene on the Wall became a UK hit on reissue, and the record went platinum in Britain while reaching the UK top twenty.

title: Solitude Standing
label: A&M Records
about: Vega's breakthrough second album, again produced by Addabbo and Kaye for A&M. Featuring Luka and an a cappella Tom's Diner, it climbed to number eleven in the US and number two in Britain and earned platinum certifications in several countries.

title: 99.9 F
label: A&M Records

tracks.t: Rock In This Pocket (Song Of David)

about: Vega's fourth studio album, produced by Mitchell Froom, moved toward electronic and industrial-tinged textures. Blood Makes Noise topped Billboard's Modern Rock chart, and the record was certified gold in the United States; Vega has named it her favorite of her albums.

title: Nine Objects Of Desire
label: A&M Records
about: Fifth studio album by Suzanne Vega, produced by Mitchell Froom and recorded in New York. It is more autobiographical than her earlier work and adds jazz and bossa nova touches, heard notably on the single Caramel.

title: Sand In The Vaseline: Popular Favorites 1976-1992
label: Sire

tracks.t: I Wish You Wouldn't Say That
This Must Be The Place (Naive Melody)

about: Two-disc Talking Heads retrospective spanning the band's career, released on Sire and Warner Bros. Alongside the hits it includes early demos, a B-side, a non-album single and three newly completed songs such as Lifetime Piling Up. It reached number seven in the UK.

artist: Thelonious Monk Quartet With John Coltrane
title: At Carnegie Hall
label: Blue Note
about: Blue Note release of a November 1957 Carnegie Hall benefit concert by Monk's quartet featuring John Coltrane. The tape sat unidentified among Voice of America recordings at the Library of Congress until Larry Appelbaum's team found it in 2005, and the album drew wide critical acclaim.

about: U2's fourteenth studio album, conceived as a companion to Songs of Innocence. Produced chiefly by Jacknife Lee and Ryan Tedder with several other contributors, it debuted at number one on the Billboard 200 and in Ireland, Canada and elsewhere.

title: Labour Of Love II
label: Virgin

tracks.t: Here I Am (Come And Take Me)
The Way You Do The Things You Do

about: UB40's ninth studio album and a second collection of reggae covers of songs by acts such as Al Green and the Temptations. Singles including Kingston Town, Here I Am and The Way You Do the Things You Do were hits in Britain and the US.

title: Best of Volume 1
label: Warner Bros. Records

tracks.t: Can't Get This Stuff No More

about: Van Halen's first greatest hits package, covering both the David Lee Roth and Sammy Hagar eras. It added two new Roth-sung tracks recorded after Hagar's departure and topped the Billboard 200.

title: Magic Time
label: Geffen Records
about: Van Morrison's thirty-first studio album, self-produced and issued by Geffen. Mixing Celtic, blues and R&B styles, it reached number three in the UK and number twenty-five in the US, and was dedicated to guitarist Foggy Lyttle.
